How AI Agents Work While You Sleep: Lauren Tan & Roshan Sadanani on Grok Bot and Grok 4.6

views.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents like colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents need their own computers and persistent identity.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体的设计要简单：像和同事聊天一样与智能体交互，而不是微观管理工具调用；智能体需要自己的电脑和持久身份。

views.en: The chat box limits agentic work; multiple specialized agents with scoped memory and shared context outperform a single general agent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为聊天框限制了智能体式工作；多个拥有限定记忆、共享上下文的专业化智能体，优于单一通用智能体。

views.en: Engineers become managers of agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control and codebase health rather than writing code.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出工程师将转变为智能体集群的管理者，关注品味、质量控制与代码库健康，而非亲自写代码。

views.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 match top models at a fraction of cost, democratizing agent use as AI costs rise.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着 AI 成本上升，Grok 4.6 这类高效模型以极低成本比肩顶级模型，推动智能体使用民主化。

views.en: Clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights; product management is becoming software.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调干净的数据基础和规范表对可信的智能体洞察至关重要；产品管理正在变成软件。

The Rise of AI Coworkers
Engineering Manager for Your Agents: Building Trust in AI-Generated Code
Building a 21+ Agent Grok Bot Team: Trust, Verification, and the Engineer as Manager
Scaling to 2,500 PRs a Month: Lauren on the Agent Trust Ladder
How I Shipped 2,500 PRs to Production with Trusted Agents

views.en: Trust is the bottleneck, not capability: constrain the codebase, add verification skills, and agents can ship thousands of PRs safely.
views.zh: 瓶颈是信任而非能力：约束代码库、赋予验证技能，智能体就能安全地每月交付数千个 PR。

views.en: Verification becomes the single most important skill; engineers shift from writing code to building the environment—skills, lints, CI, type systems.
views.zh: 验证成为最重要的技能；工程师从写代码转向搭建环境——技能、lint、CI、类型系统。

views.en: Trust is built incrementally up a ladder: read-only first, then action-taking, then auto-merging PRs reviewed after landing.
views.zh: 信任沿阶梯逐步建立：先只读，再行动，最后自动合并 PR、落地后再审查。

views.en: The engineer becomes a manager of agents; hard enforcement via CI, lints, and architecture beats soft rules and skills.
views.zh: 工程师变成智能体的管理者；通过 CI、lint 和架构的硬性约束胜过软规则与技能。

views.en: As execution becomes abundant, the bottleneck shifts to intent, vision, and taste; bots are teammates, not chatbots.
views.zh: 当执行变得充裕，瓶颈转向意图、愿景与品味；机器人是队友，而非聊天机器人。

episodes.tEn: How Physical AI Learns Across Language, Video and Action

people.bioEn: Machine learning researcher, co-inventor of the variational autoencoder and a pioneer of graph and equivariant neural networks. Professor at the University of Amsterdam and co-founder and CTO of CuspAI, which uses generative AI to design new materials.
people.bioZh: 机器学习研究者，变分自编码器（VAE）的共同提出者，图神经网络与等变网络的先驱。阿姆斯特丹大学教授，CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO，用生成式 AI 设计新材料。

episodes.tEn: Why the Next AI Breakthrough May Come from Physics
Max Welling: Physics, Symmetry, and AI for Materials Discovery

views.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
views.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现都通过它连接起来。

views.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
views.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引巨额投资。

views.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
views.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

views.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
views.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

views.en: The vision empowers chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
views.zh: 这一愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 健康 AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Leads health AI at OpenAI, training medical expertise into general-purpose frontier models and building ChatGPT's health features. Previously at Google Research, where he led work on the Med-PaLM medical language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 健康 AI 负责人，把医学能力训练进通用前沿模型并打造 ChatGPT 的健康功能。此前在 Google Research 领导 Med-PaLM 医疗大模型的研究。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Head of Health AI on Trusting ChatGPT with Your Health

people.tiZh: Unconventional AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Unconventional AI, an AI hardware startup rethinking how AI systems are built and powered. Previously founded Nervana Systems (acquired by Intel), co-founded MosaicML (acquired by Databricks for $1.3B) and served as VP of AI at Databricks.
people.bioZh: AI 硬件公司 Unconventional AI 创始人兼 CEO。此前创办 Nervana Systems（被英特尔收购），联合创办 MosaicML（被 Databricks 以 13 亿美元收购），并任 Databricks AI 副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Inference Will Be a $10 Trillion Market: Naveen Rao on Energy, Hardware, and the AI Buildout

people.tiZh: MIT 博士生、Sakana AI
people.bioEn: PhD student at MIT working with Phillip Isola and collaborator of Sakana AI. Led ASAL, which uses foundation models to search spaces of artificial life, and is first author of the Fractured Entangled Representation paper with Kenneth Stanley, Jeff Clune and Joel Lehman.
people.bioZh: MIT 博士生，师从 Phillip Isola，并与 Sakana AI 合作。主导了用基础模型搜索人工生命空间的 ASAL 项目，与 Kenneth Stanley、Jeff Clune、Joel Lehman 合著「断裂纠缠表征」论文并任第一作者。

episodes.tEn: What Most People Get Wrong About Evolution: Artificial Life, Open-Endedness, and Intelligence Beyond Earth

people.tiZh: Weco 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Weco, which builds AIDE, an AI agent for machine learning engineering and code optimization. His work studies recursive self-improvement by letting agents rewrite their own harness.
people.bioZh: Weco 联合创始人。Weco 打造机器学习工程与代码优化智能体 AIDE，他的研究方向是让智能体改写自身框架、探索递归自我改进。

episodes.tEn: Can Rewriting an AI Agent Bend the Intelligence Curve?

people.tiZh: MIT 数学系教授
people.bioEn: Theoretical computer scientist and professor of mathematics at MIT, working on algorithms, the theory of machine learning and high-dimensional statistics.
people.bioZh: 理论计算机科学家，MIT 数学系教授，研究算法、机器学习理论与高维统计。

episodes.tEn: AI Crisis in Mathematics: Navier-Stokes, Riemann Hypothesis, and Complexity Theory — Ankur Moitra, Steven Brunton, and Alex Kontorovich on the Future of Math

people.tiEn: Startup Advisor, Author of The Power of Pull
people.tiZh: 创业顾问,《The Power of Pull》作者
people.bioEn: Rob Snyder is a startup advisor and author of The Power of Pull, who has advised over 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR. He writes the newsletter The Physics of Startups and focuses on frameworks for finding product-market fit.
people.bioZh: 罗布·斯奈德是一位创业顾问,著有《The Power of Pull》,曾为 50 多家初创公司提供从零增长到 100 万美元 ARR 的咨询。他撰写通讯《The Physics of Startups》,专注于寻找产品市场契合度的框架。

episodes.tEn: The Power of Pull: Why Customer Demand Beats Pain Points
An 86-Minute Guide to Finding Product-Market Fit

views.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: a project someone must act on now, with options and limitations.
views.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性：一个人有一个当下必须推进的项目，同时有可选方案和限制条件。

views.en: Skip design partners, pilots and interviews; sell directly and treat sales as research into real willingness to buy.
views.zh: 跳过设计伙伴、试点和访谈；直接销售，把销售当作对真实购买意愿的研究。

views.en: Start with one hell-yes customer, then build a repeatable case-study factory before automating anything.
views.zh: 先找到一个“绝对要买”的客户，再打造可复制的案例工厂，之后才谈自动化。

views.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, prove demand, and only then build product.
views.zh: 技术放在最后：先以服务形式销售、验证需求，然后才构建产品。

views.en: Go to the gemba and observe where people are stuck; interviews lack a truth-seeking mechanism like purchase.
views.zh: 去现场观察人们卡在哪里；访谈缺乏像购买那样的求真机制。

people.tiZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, Buildspace 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Hey Clicky and previously Buildspace, one of the largest online schools for people building their own ideas. He has made videos for over a decade, with posts regularly reaching millions of views.
people.bioZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, 此前创办 Buildspace——最大的在线创意建造学校之一。他做视频已超过十年, 作品常获数百万播放。

episodes.tEn: How to Actually Make Launch Videos That Convert

people.tiZh: Magic Patterns 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alex Danilowicz is a front-end engineer and co-founder of Magic Patterns, one of the first teams building prompt-to-design tools in 2023. Magic Patterns helps product teams turn ideas into interactive, code-backed prototypes in minutes.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·丹尼洛维奇是一名前端工程师，也是 Magic Patterns 的联合创始人。该团队是 2023 年最早构建提示词生成设计工具的团队之一，帮助产品团队在几分钟内把想法变成可交互、带代码的原型。

episodes.tEn: How to Stand Out in an AI Design World: Inside Magic Patterns

people.tiZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Moshi, building AI-powered recommendation and research tools for commodity traders. Background in mathematics and trading.
people.bioZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO，为大宗商品交易员打造 AI 推荐与研究工具。拥有数学与交易背景。

episodes.tEn: Building the Recommendation Engine for Commodity Traders

people.tiZh: Modal 首席执行官
people.bioEn: CEO and founder of Modal, a serverless cloud platform for AI compute. Previously CTO at Better and engineering leader at Spotify, where he built its recommendation system.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席执行官兼创始人，Modal 是面向 AI 计算的无服务器云平台。此前曾任 Better 首席技术官，并在 Spotify 担任工程负责人，主导构建其推荐系统。

episodes.tEn: Modal CEO Erik: The $100B Inference Opportunity and Why Open-Source LLM Inference Hasn't Peaked
Modal CEO Erik on Agent Maxxing, Inference's Future, and the GPU Market's Chaos
Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles: Erik Bernhardsson on Building Modal

views.en: AI infrastructure must be rebuilt from scratch for GPU workloads, not wrapped over Kubernetes and Docker; developer experience and agent experience share the same foundations.
views.zh: AI 基础设施必须为 GPU 工作负载从零重建，而非在 Kubernetes 和 Docker 上包装；开发者体验与智能体体验共享相同的基础。

views.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable at higher prices and longer terms; aggregating demand across 25+ clouds smooths capacity and avoids knife-fighting.
views.zh: 算力稀缺但可通过更高价格和更长合约获得；聚合 25+ 云的需求可平滑容量并避免抢购。

views.en: Inference will be an enormous market like the new cloud, requiring a full platform of post-training, sandboxes, and agentic tools; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom.
views.zh: 推理将像新云一样成为巨大市场，需要后训练、沙盒和智能体工具的完整平台；仅卖 token 是逐底竞争。

views.en: Durable differentiation comes from a multi-product platform and proprietary infra alpha (file system, container runtime, scheduler), not just cheap token serving or CUDA moat.
views.zh: 持久差异化来自多产品平台和专有基础设施优势（文件系统、容器运行时、调度器），而非廉价 token 服务或 CUDA 护城河。

views.en: Post-training works for finite feedback loops like coding but may face limits for longer-horizon tasks; open-source models are good enough off the shelf, making fine-tuning optional.
views.zh: 后训练适用于编码等有限反馈循环，但长周期任务可能受限；开源模型开箱即用已足够好，微调不再必需。

people.tiZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Mecka AI, which operates one of the largest robot data factories, building custom hardware and pipelines to collect egocentric human and robot data for training embodied models.
people.bioZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO，运营着规模最大的机器人数据工厂之一，通过自研硬件与数据管线采集第一人称人类数据和机器人数据，用于训练具身模型。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Robot Data Factory: Mecka's Josh Gao on Sensorizing Humans to Train Robots

people.tiZh: SF Compute 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of SF Compute, a marketplace and independent operator for buying and selling GPU compute capacity.
people.bioZh: SF Compute 联合创始人，该公司是 GPU 算力买卖的市场平台与独立运营商。

episodes.tEn: The Programmable Data Center: Evan Conrad of SF Compute

people.tiZh: Inflight 联合创始人、产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer and co-founder of Inflight, with design experience at Tinder, Facebook, and Airchat.
people.bioZh: 产品设计师、Inflight 联合创始人，曾在 Tinder、Facebook 和 Airchat 从事设计工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing Inflight: A Designer's Raw 0-to-1 Startup Journey

people.tiZh: Robinhood 联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Vladimir Tenev is the co-founder, chairman, and CEO of Robinhood. Born in Bulgaria, he moved to the United States at age five, studied mathematics at Stanford and UCLA, and started the brokerage with Baiju Bhatt.
people.bioZh: 弗拉基米尔·特内夫是 Robinhood 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO。他出生于保加利亚，五岁移居美国，在斯坦福和 UCLA 学习数学，并与 Baiju Bhatt 一起创办了这家券商。

episodes.tEn: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev on Tokenization, Agentic Trading, and Expanding Ownership
Robinhood’s CEO on Letting AI Trade Your Money

views.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; AI is too centralized, so tools should empower individuals rather than secretive labs.
views.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由的路径；AI 过于中心化，工具应赋权个人，而非服务于拥有秘密模型的实验室。

views.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show strong adoption.
views.zh: 智能体式交易已找到明确的产品市场契合：15 万账户与每日 3000 万次工具调用显示出强劲采用。

views.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies.
views.zh: 代币化把所有权扩展到全球，让任何拥有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私营公司。

views.en: Accredited investor rules are outdated; retail investors should access private companies early, not just institutions.
views.zh: 合格投资者规则已经过时；散户应能尽早投资私营公司，而不只是机构。

views.en: A corporation-managed blockchain can beat decentralized purity through focused leadership and trusted primitives.
views.zh: 由公司管理的区块链可以凭借专注的领导力和可信的基础组件，胜过追求纯粹去中心化的做法。

people.tiZh: 高通总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Cristiano Amon is President and CEO of Qualcomm. He joined as an engineer in 1995, led its 5G strategy and the Snapdragon platforms, and became CEO in 2021, taking the company from phones into PCs, cars, wearables and data-center AI.
people.bioZh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·安蒙是高通总裁兼 CEO。他 1995 年以工程师身份加入高通，主导 5G 战略与骁龙平台，2021 年出任 CEO，并把公司从手机拓展到 PC、汽车、可穿戴设备与数据中心 AI。

episodes.tEn: Qualcomm’s CEO on the Coming AI Phone Supercycle
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Reinventing Beyond the Phone
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on AI, Geopolitics, and the Gladiator Mindset
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Rise of Agentic AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the 6G Era and the Next AI Device
Beyond the Smartphone: Cristiano Amon on Qualcomm's AI Revolution and the Global Bridge
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

episodes.tEn: Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Personal AI Devices and the Agentic Future of Mobile
Qualcomm CEO on Robotics, Chips and Competition with China
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Future of AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: The Next Mobile Revolution
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the AI-Driven Transformation of Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: We’re in a Hurry to Get to the Future
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on 5G, Snapdragon, and the Future of Mobile Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Leading the Chip Giant Beyond Mobile

views.en: 5G as critical infrastructure brings cloud compute to every device; Qualcomm diversifies beyond mobile into auto, IoT, PC, and AR.
views.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，把云端算力带到每台设备；高通从手机向汽车、物联网、PC 和 AR 多元化。

views.en: Chips anchor the connected intelligent edge; autonomous driving arrives incrementally, AR glasses are the next platform in 5-10 years.
views.zh: 2022 年，他强调芯片是连接智能边缘的锚点；自动驾驶渐进落地，AR 眼镜是 5-10 年后的下一代平台。

views.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency, and data-center offload.
views.zh: 2024 年，他从无线转向“无处不在的智能计算”；混合 AI 把端侧与云端分工，兼顾隐私、时延和数据中心卸载。

views.en: Agents become the new center of digital life; glasses and wearables orbit them, while inference and power efficiency decide data-center winners.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体成为数字生活的新中心，眼镜与可穿戴围绕它运转；推理与能效决定数据中心赢家。

views.en: A consistent line: power-efficient heterogeneous compute, engineering culture, and reinvention from radio into new computing spaces.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：高能效异构计算、工程文化，以及从无线通信不断重塑进入新计算空间。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Emmanuel Ameisen is an interpretability researcher at Anthropic, studying how large language models like Claude form concepts and plan ahead. He previously worked in applied ML at Stripe and Insight and authored Building Machine Learning Powered Applications.
people.bioZh: Emmanuel Ameisen 是 Anthropic 的可解释性研究员，研究 Claude 等大语言模型如何形成概念、如何提前规划。他此前在 Stripe 和 Insight 从事应用机器学习工作，并著有《Building Machine Learning Powered Applications》。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Mind of AI: An Anthropic Researcher on How Models Really Work

people.tiZh: Metalab 设计总监
people.bioEn: Design Director at Metalab, where he builds internal AI tooling systems and custom AI tools for design teams.
people.bioZh: Metalab 设计总监，为设计团队构建内部 AI 工具系统与定制化 AI 工具。

episodes.tEn: Building Custom AI Design Tools at Metalab

people.tiZh: Dyna Robotics 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jason Ma is co-founder and Chief Scientist at Dyna Robotics, where he works on world-action models and general-purpose robot learning from large-scale human video. His research focuses on robot learning, reinforcement learning, and physical AI systems deployed in real-world production.
people.bioZh: 马杰森是 Dyna Robotics 的联合创始人兼首席科学家，专注于世界-动作模型以及从大规模人类视频中学习通用机器人技能。他的研究聚焦于机器人学习、强化学习，以及部署到真实生产环境中的物理 AI 系统。

episodes.tEn: Robots That Predict the Future: Dyna-2 and Physical AI with Jason Ma

people.tiZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Leash Bio, which builds DNA-encoded libraries and large-scale experimental datasets to train models that learn real chemistry. Works on turning wet-lab measurements into reinforcement-learning environments for drug-discovery agents.
people.bioZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO，通过 DNA 编码化合物库与大规模实验数据训练真正理解化学的模型，并致力于把湿实验测量转化为药物发现智能体的强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: From Wet Lab to RL Env: 10,000 Drug-Discovery Campaigns in a Weekend — Ian Quigley, Leash Bio

people.tiZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini 应用副总裁
people.bioEn: Josh Woodward is the VP of Google Labs and head of the Gemini app and AI Studio. He has spent over 17 years at Google, overseeing its largest labs team behind products like NotebookLM, Project Genie, and Flow.
people.bioZh: 乔什·伍德沃德是 Google Labs 副总裁，负责 Gemini 应用与 AI Studio。他在 Google 工作超过 17 年，掌管其规模最大的实验室团队，主导了 NotebookLM、Project Genie 和 Flow 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why Every Company Now Needs to Think and Operate Like a Lab Team

people.tiEn: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco
people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy and AI infrastructure efforts, including networking for GPU clusters and securing AI agents.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司产品战略与 AI 基础设施业务，包括面向 GPU 集群的网络与 AI 智能体的安全。

episodes.tEn: Jeetu Patel: Building Products for the AI Era
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

views.en: AI will create more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure is consumed instantly.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，真正的瓶颈在人；AI 基础设施严重供不应求，需求瞬间吃光供给。

views.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct, not to outsource thinking; skipping the reps is a long-term mistake.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调要用 AI 更快学习、建立直觉，而不是外包思考；跳过练习是长期错误。

views.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, ride it as a tailwind.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，要顺势而为。

views.en: Cisco is now an AI infrastructure company selling picks and shovels: networking, security, silicon; missing cloud but winning hyperscaler AI revenue.
views.zh: 2026 年他把思科定位为 AI 基础设施公司，卖铲子：网络、安全、芯片；错过云但靠早期芯片押注赢得超大规模 AI 收入。

views.en: Operate like the world's largest startup: speed with scale, founder mode, and unlearning past experience as a critical AI skill.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出要像全球最大初创公司那样运营：规模中保持速度、创始人模式，并把忘掉旧经验当作关键 AI 技能。

people.tiZh: Bending Spoons 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Luca Ferrari is co-founder and CEO of Bending Spoons, a software company that acquires and operates products such as Evernote, Vimeo, AOL and Airtable. He is known for running hiring and operations with a heavily data-driven, quantitative approach.
people.bioZh: 卢卡·法拉利是 Bending Spoons 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司收购并运营 Evernote、Vimeo、AOL、Airtable 等产品。他以高度数据驱动、量化的招聘与运营方式著称。

episodes.tEn: Luca Ferrari: The Operating System Behind Bending Spoons

people.tiZh: OpenAI Dots 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Alexander Embiricos leads product for Dots, OpenAI's always-on personal AI agents that act without waiting for a prompt, after previously leading Codex. He co-founded and ran the collaboration startup Multi, which OpenAI acquired in 2024.
people.bioZh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯是 OpenAI Dots 的产品负责人——Dots 是无需等待指令就能主动帮用户做事的常驻个人 AI 智能体；此前他负责 Codex 产品。他曾联合创办协作软件公司 Multi 并任 CEO，该公司 2024 年被 OpenAI 收购。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Dots Lead on the Future of ChatGPT and Personal Agents

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT & Codex (Core Products), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 负责人（核心产品）
people.bioEn: Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux leads OpenAI's core products, spanning ChatGPT, Codex and the Dots personal-agent platform. A Belgian engineer, he previously worked on Google Maps and ML infrastructure at Google DeepMind, where he briefly led Gemini's human-data team before joining OpenAI in 2024 as an engineering lead for Codex.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥统管 OpenAI 核心产品线，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台。他是比利时工程师，曾在 Google 做 Google Maps，后在 Google DeepMind 负责机器学习基础设施并短暂领导 Gemini 人类数据团队，2024 年加入 OpenAI 任 Codex 工程负责人。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux on Putting Humans at the Center of AI
Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

views.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops, take most internet actions; human taste and empathy become the scarce skills.
views.zh: 为未来构建：持续学习的智能体而非手动循环将承担大多数互联网操作；人类品味与共情成为稀缺技能。

views.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement already happens under human supervision.
views.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

views.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary for generality.
views.zh: 随着模型自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）可能已经到来；世界模型对通用性或许并非必需。

views.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; eliminate model pickers and configuration fatigue.
views.zh: 共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波；消除模型选择器和配置疲劳。

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Why OpenAI Is Racing to Make Computer Use Superhuman
Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

views.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed; the bottleneck shifts from model intelligence to website load time and harness design.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 已越过人类速度门槛；瓶颈从模型智能转向网站加载时间与 harness 设计。

views.en: Agents now drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot loops, completing the dev lifecycle.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体借助无障碍树与 DOM 而非截图循环操作所有人类软件，并能自测代码、走完开发闭环。

views.en: Universal computer use beats API-only integration; enterprises need sandboxing, deterministic controls and human-in-the-loop dials.
views.zh: 2026 年，通用 computer use 胜过纯 API 集成；企业需要沙箱、确定性控制与人类在环旋钮来建立信任。

views.en: Proactivity is the adoption lever: agents adapt to users, while legacy UI and human browsing coexist rather than vanish.
views.zh: 2026 年，主动性是落地杠杆：智能体适应用户，旧有 UI 与人类浏览共存而非消失。

views.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise at once; startups keep a moat in deep workflows.
views.zh: 2026 年，computer use 在消费与企业两端同时进入 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；初创公司在深度工作流上仍有护城河。

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than the willingness to learn and build for the market; speed and customer feedback are the startup's edge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调领域专业知识不如学习和为市场构建的意愿重要，速度与客户反馈是创业公司的优势。

views.en: Don't fine-tune models; bet on model improvements and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张不要微调模型，而应押注模型进步，为 3-6 个月后的模型能力而构建。

views.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we're only at mile one of a long marathon.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 现在是最差的时刻，我们才刚跑完漫长马拉松的第一英里。

views.en: Hiring for growth potential and investing in culture during good times builds a cushion for downturns.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张按成长潜力招聘，并在顺境时投资文化与团队，为低谷积累缓冲。

views.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people, and recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为领导者应通过招聘更聪明的人让自己变得可替代，招聘是特权而非义务。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Replit's Amjad Masad on Building the Browser IDE and the Future of Programming
Building the Future: Paul Graham & Amjad Masad on Vibe Coding and AI Agents
Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and coders remain needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让软件创造人人可及；token 补充而非取代人力资本，程序员仍需理解系统、排查深层问题。

views.en: Vibe coding was not a sudden leap: users were already 50-60% AI-assisted, and the early harness was 10x more complex because models were weaker.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 vibe coding 并非突变：用户此前已获 50-60%的 AI 辅助，早期 harness 因模型更弱而复杂十倍。

views.en: Agents became usable around April 2025 and business-grade by October 2025; safety should focus on containing rogue agents like malware, not just alignment research.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体约在 2025 年 4 月变得可用、10 月达到可支撑业务的程度；安全应像遏制恶意软件那样遏制失控智能体，而不只是做对齐研究。

views.en: Pre-training frontier models is too capital-intensive; Replit focuses on routing, security and cost, while enterprises adopt open-weight and specialized models to avoid lock-in.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为预训练前沿模型过于资本密集；Replit 转向路由、安全与成本，企业则采用开放权重与专用模型以避免锁定。

views.en: The next vision is the self-driving company: agents enable true autonomy, and everyone becomes an entrepreneur as AI handles coordination and information sharing.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出下一愿景是自驱动公司：智能体带来真正自主，人人成为创业者，AI 承担协调与信息共享。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Become a Eureka Machine? Richard Socher on AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

views.en: Superintelligence excites him most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable since AI can code, but slow takeoff is bounded by hardware and economics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他最期待超级智能推动科学发现；他认为递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但起飞是缓慢的，受硬件与经济约束。

views.en: Regulate applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; doing the latter means surveilling thought.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张监管具体应用、由使用者担责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；后者等于监控思想。

views.en: Language remains the key to intelligence; world models are overrated while language models have far more room to grow.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍视语言为智能的关键；认为世界模型被高估，语言模型还有大得多的成长空间。

views.en: Open source and open weights make AI safer by multiplying good actors; slowing frontier labs is unrealistic as they race competitors.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源与开放权重让更多善意的参与者加入，从而更安全；让前沿实验室减速不现实，因为它们正相互竞赛。

views.en: Hard takeoff, immediate job loss, and paperclip scenarios are overblown; capitalism and slow physical constraints act as safety features.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为硬起飞、立即失业与回形针场景都被夸大；资本主义与缓慢的物理约束本身就是安全阀。

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: Jev Creator Diogo Almeida on AI Reliability, US vs Chinese Models, and the Cost of Intelligence
A Month After Going Viral: Jev's Creator on Coding Agents, Benchmarks & AI's Reliability Gap
Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and miscalibration.
views.zh: 大多数 LLM 被优化为人类在环的辅助工具，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效。

views.en: Data and the right task matter more than compute; the bitter lesson is wrong, and scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
views.zh: 数据与选对任务比算力更重要；「苦涩教训」是错的，缩放定律只在数据与任务正确时成立。

views.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, is the real bottleneck; models are Einstein 95% of the time, Mr. Bean 5%.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是可靠性，而非速度、成本或基准分数；模型 95% 像爱因斯坦，5% 像憨豆先生。

views.en: RLHF destroyed calibration; RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs, and post-training breakthroughs, not pre-training, drive 10x jumps.
views.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准；RLCD 把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮，10 倍跃升靠后训练而非预训练。

views.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation; automate easy, economically valuable tasks first, and keep humans in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
views.zh: 编程智能体是辅助而非自动化；应先自动化简单且有经济价值的任务，高风险决策仍须人类在环。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the bridge from models to enterprise workflows is vast and requires a lot of software.
views.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流之间的桥梁极其宽广，需要大量软件来搭建。

views.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
views.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只审阅结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary.
views.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
views.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期的慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

views.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和对齐研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

views.en: AI agent swarms will overwhelm current security models, requiring new access controls; innovation is shifting from model layer to application layer.
views.zh: 智能体集群将压垮现有安全模型，需要新的访问控制；创新正从模型层转向应用层。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 的扩散需要十年，企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更关键。

views.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence is far away.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断当前生存风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，超级智能仍很遥远。

views.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出放慢前沿节奏与安全无关，慢慢造武器并不会更安全。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement needs less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatability — none are happening.
views.zh: 2026 年他用四个条件拆解递归自我改进，指出算力、时间等条件都不成立，多数说法只是自催化效应。

views.en: Security must be automated with agents; open source dominates tokens but not dollar spend.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张用智能体自动化安全，并指出开源模型按 token 占优但按花费仅占少数。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Stop Planning for 2027: How OpenAI Ships Product in 90-Day Cycles
Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

views.en: Ship imperfect products fast to gather empirical evidence; build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out.
views.zh: 快速发布不完美的产品以获取经验证据；为模型在 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非为当下或一年后构建。

views.en: Agents handle tactical work while humans steer; ambition and empirical iteration matter more than academic theory.
views.zh: 智能体处理战术性工作，人类负责掌舵；雄心和经验式迭代比学术理论更重要。

views.en: Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile; urgency and 90-day cycles beat polished long-term plans.
views.zh: 超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的；紧迫感和 90 天周期胜过精雕细琢的长期计划。

views.en: Single identity agents may not scale; bundling them like a chief of staff is key, and voice will be a major form factor by 2027.
views.zh: 单一身份智能体可能无法扩展；像幕僚长一样将它们捆绑是关键，而语音到 2027 年将成为主要产品形态。

views.en: The slow takeoff scenario is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; writing as thinking should not be automated.
views.zh: 慢速起飞场景正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然出现超级智能；作为思考的写作不应被自动化。

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Future and Business of AI: A Conversation with Kevin Roose and Ethan Mollick
AI Agents Could Break the Banking System — With Ethan Mollick
episodes.podEn: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and juniors misuse it without expertise.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术：当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异与真实观点反而更值钱；而缺乏专业积累的年轻人往往用不好 AI。

views.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, so the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface and from prompting to delegation.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立执行长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面，从反复提示转向任务委派。

views.en: The paradox of delegation: handing work to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts and new formal assessment matter more.
views.zh: 他提出委派悖论：把任务交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家与新的正式评估更重要，传统学徒制已断裂。

views.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more work worth attempting.
views.zh: 2026 年秋，他强调 AI 的锯齿状前沿与采用滞后使人类仍不可替代；更多 AI 降低组织成本，反而创造更多值得尝试的工作。

views.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; give it harder tasks, and rebuild organizations rather than chase incremental productivity.
views.zh: 到 2026 年底，他主张把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非答案机，给它更难的任务，并从头重建组织，而非追求渐进式生产率目标。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based forecasts while being far faster.
views.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上比肩传统物理模型，速度却快出数万倍。

views.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
views.zh: 把球面几何等领域结构嵌入模型，是长期气候建模稳定的关键，也让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

views.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness, not just benchmark wins, to be reliable in physical applications.
views.zh: AI for science 需要原则化的验证与鲁棒性，而非只追求基准成绩，才能在物理应用中可靠。

views.en: A universal physics foundation model can self-improve using PDEs as dense training signals, outperforming pure data-driven approaches and even its training data.
views.zh: 通用物理基础模型可用 PDE 作为稠密训练信号自我改进，超越纯数据驱动方法，甚至超越训练数据本身。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain, not just enlarging model size.
views.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每个领域的表现，而不只是靠扩大模型规模。

views.en: Transformers' quadratic complexity cannot handle trillion-token physical contexts; physical world structure demands alternative architectures and reinvented sharding.
views.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度无法承载万亿级物理上下文；物理世界结构要求替代架构，并重新设计分片基础设施。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Has DHH Working 16-Hour Days
Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Agents now write better code than most professionals; hand-coding is becoming economically unproductive and an exceptional state.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体写代码已优于多数专业程序员，手写代码在经济上不再划算，正变成一种例外状态。

views.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scripts make it the ideal OS for agents; macOS and Windows are unfit for the agentic era.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张 Linux 的命令行、配置文件和脚本使其成为智能体的理想操作系统，而 macOS 与 Windows 不适合智能体时代。

views.en: English now expresses intent better than Ruby; abstraction and repetition cost matter less, so describe outcomes not implementations.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，抽象与重复成本不再重要，应描述结果而非实现细节。

views.en: Human taste and vision still matter for the last 2%, but superintelligence in software may arrive within a year.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为人类品味与愿景对最后 2% 的完美至关重要，但软件开发领域的超级智能可能一年内到来。

views.en: Open source and open weights are essential to keep frontier labs honest; AI doom focus breeds psychosis, so build instead.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源与开放权重是让前沿实验室保持诚实的关键，并批评过度聚焦 AI 末日论会催生 AI 精神病，应专注建设。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
views.zh: 智能体对网页的检索量将达人类千倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

views.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
views.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的；智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

views.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time to align incentives.
views.zh: 现有形式的广告对智能体无效；必须在推理时向内容方付费，才能对齐激励。

views.en: Pre-training crawls are useless for fresh indexes; agentic search needs completionist crawling and Shapley-value estimation of content worth.
views.zh: 预训练抓取对新鲜索引无用；智能体式搜索需要完备抓取，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值。

views.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for.
views.zh: 网页正从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并行动，形成发布方必须同时优化的平行网络。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: How SpaceXAI Designers Use Grok Bot and Figma MCP to Ship Faster
Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

views.en: Chat-based interfaces remain the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
views.zh: 聊天式界面仍是与智能体交互的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤。

views.en: AI should get you off the computer, automating tasks so you can live your life; designers move up the stack to taste and delight.
views.zh: AI 应让人离开电脑、自动完成任务以回归生活；设计师应上移到品味与愉悦感层面。

views.en: AI lowers the cost of making things, enabling rapid prototyping and a throwaway approach that encourages creativity.
views.zh: AI 降低创造成本，支持快速原型与“可丢弃”式开发，从而激发创造力。

views.en: Bots with specific use cases and simple building blocks connected by AI are powerful; delegate email and calendar to them.
views.zh: 具备具体用例、由 AI 连接简单积木的机器人很强大；把邮件和日历交给它们。

views.en: Designers should not fear AI; it frees them from mundane production work and unlocks inaccessible skills.
views.zh: 设计师不应畏惧 AI；它把人从琐碎生产工作中解放，并解锁原本难以掌握的技能。

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
views.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，不设很快过时的硬性红线。

views.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated, so regulate model outputs rather than training.
views.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 出台且已过时，应监管模型输出而非训练过程。

views.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should avoid alarm-driven containment.
views.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成真——政策应避免恐慌驱动的遏制。

views.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, since private sector now dominates funding.
views.zh: 政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发并直接资助科学家个人而非机构，因为私营部门已主导资金。

views.en: Science is politicized and stagnant; the Genesis mission applies AI to double US scientific output, competing with China in AI, quantum, nuclear, bio.
views.zh: 科学已被政治化且停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 使美国科学产出翻倍，在 AI、量子、核、生物领域与中国竞争。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett on Beating China, Racing Tesla, and the Humanoid Timeline
Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; the bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and vertical integration is mandatory.
views.zh: 人形机器人是最大的生意；瓶颈在智能而非制造，垂直整合是必须的。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data is the key pre-training prior for robotics.
views.zh: 最大约束是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域关键的预训练先验。

views.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve: more data and compute yield log-linear gains, echoing the GPT-1 phase.
views.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来对数线性提升，类似 GPT-1 阶段。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; zero-shot generalization could be demonstrated as soon as this year.
views.zh: 泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯；零样本泛化可能今年就能演示。

views.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the end state is BCI, not wearables, and the home is more solvable than commercial settings.
views.zh: AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；终局是脑机接口而非可穿戴，家庭比商业场景更可解。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Manufacturing 50,000 Humanoid Robots Next Year | Bernt Børnich, 1X
Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

views.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; real-world reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
views.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；真实世界的可靠性与管理用户预期，比演示更重要。

views.en: From friendly interaction to production: prototypes are easy, production is hard, and scaling volume requires crossing quality gates.
views.zh: 从友好交互走向量产：原型容易、生产困难，Scaling（规模扩张）必须跨过质量关卡。

views.en: General models, not per-task automation, are key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
views.zh: 关键在于通用模型而非逐任务自动化；数据多样性而非数量，才是机器人智能的瓶颈。

views.en: Models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions rather than clone human behavior.
views.zh: 模型应学习世界模型（world model）并搜索最优解，而不是克隆人类行为。

views.en: Safety and trust remain the constant prerequisite; in-house manufacturing and small teams enable fast iteration toward home deployment.
views.zh: 安全与信任始终是前提；自建制造与小团队带来快速迭代，指向家庭部署。

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brendan Foody is the CEO of Mercor, a company focused on AI training data and RL environments.
people.bioZh: 布伦丹·富迪是 Mercor 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 训练数据和强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: Mercor Raises $750M at $20B Valuation: CEO Brendan Foody on Reinventing How Humans Work
Mercor's Brendan Foody on Data, Evals & the Last Human Job
RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

views.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向强化学习环境，强调人类在多数领域仍是构建验证器与评分标准的关键。

views.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; building evals is the real bottleneck, and RL saturates any eval fast.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切构建评测，而强化学习一旦有评测就会迅速饱和。

views.en: Humans' last job is creating training data and evals; people shift from repetitive work to training agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把“人类最后的工作”定义为造数据与做评测，人从重复劳动转向训练智能体。

views.en: Models can't grade their own homework; recursive self-improvement stalls in non-verifiable domains, so human eval data stays essential.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调模型无法可靠地给自己打分，在不可验证领域递归自我改进受限，因此人类评测数据不可替代。

views.en: Enterprises will build sovereign AI stacks on proprietary data; every Fortune 500 becomes a neolab, and data remains mispriced.
views.zh: 最近他进一步主张企业不会把数据交给前沿模型实验室，每家财富 500 强都将成为自训模型的新实验室，而市场仍低估人类反馈数据的价值。

people.tiZh: Exo 创始人
people.bioEn: Alex Krentsel is the founder of Exo, a systems approach to recursive self-improvement for AI agents, focusing on full visibility into code and logs.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·克伦塞尔是 Exo 的创始人，Exo 是一种 AI 代理递归自我改进的系统方法，专注于对代码和日志的完全可见性。

episodes.tEn: EXO: Fully Recursive Self-Improving Agents

people.tiZh: Cursor 人才负责人
people.bioEn: Adam Ward is the Head of Talent at Cursor, with over 20 years of experience building elite teams in AI and tech companies.
people.bioZh: 亚当·沃德是 Cursor 的人才负责人，拥有 20 多年在 AI 和科技公司打造精英团队的经验。

episodes.tEn: Building Elite High Talent Density Teams with Adam Ward

people.bioEn: Co-founder of Chai Discovery (Chai-1/Chai-2 protein models). CS PhD from University of Chicago, former research scientist intern at Meta.

people.bioEn: Adam Brown is a physicist who has taught a graduate course on general relativity at Stanford, known for his clear explanations of complex physical concepts.
people.bioZh: 亚当·布朗是一位物理学家，曾在斯坦福教授广义相对论研究生课程，以清晰解释复杂物理概念而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Understanding General Relativity: Einstein's Most Beautiful Idea

people.tiZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官
people.bioEn: Co-President and Chief Product & Technology Officer at Spotify, overseeing product, design, data and engineering. Previously founded 13th Lab (acquired by Oculus) and led Yahoo Mobile; the main architect of Spotify's bet-driven product culture and its AI/ML strategy from Discover Weekly to the AI DJ.
people.bioZh: Spotify 联席总裁兼首席产品技术官,统管产品、设计、数据与工程。曾创办 13th Lab(被 Oculus 收购)、负责雅虎移动业务;是 Spotify「下注驱动」产品文化与 AI/ML 战略(从 Discover Weekly 到 AI DJ)的主要设计者。

episodes.tEn: From Co-President to Co-CEO: Inside Spotify's Unusual Succession
Navigating the AI Wave: Spotify's Strategic Shift
How Large Language Models Actually Work
From Curation to Generation: Spotify's Gustav Söderström on AI and Product Evolution

views.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression via simple scaling, not complex design.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩，其突破源于简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计。

views.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出互联网正从策展转向生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，并强调容错界面需匹配算法性能。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; companies must rebuild infrastructure, not just add AI features.
views.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业需重建基础设施，而非仅添加 AI 功能，并指出当前对大公司的影响被高估。

views.en: Inference marginal cost will force business model changes; Spotify acts as music industry's R&D department.
views.zh: 2025 年，他预警推理边际成本将迫使商业模式变革，并重申 Spotify 作为音乐产业研发部门的定位。

views.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; prioritize 'time well spent'.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾，优先考虑‘时间花得值’，并强调技术变革期率先采用是关键。

people.tiZh: Science 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Hodak is the CEO of Science, a company developing retinal implants to restore vision. He previously co-founded Transcriptic and was a co-founder of Neuralink.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·霍达克是 Science 公司的 CEO，该公司正在开发视网膜植入物以恢复视力。他曾共同创立 Transcriptic，并是 Neuralink 的联合创始人之一。

episodes.tEn: Restoring Vision with Retinal Implants: A Conversation with Max Hodak
Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能解开深科技困局。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; custom internal software beats bought ERP.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品，自建内部软件优于采购商用 ERP。

views.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

views.en: Retinal implants are BCI and a viable business, extending the field beyond motor decoding.
views.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI 与可行生意，将领域从运动解码扩展到视觉恢复。

views.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

people.zh: 凯勒·里纳乌多·克利夫顿

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Zipline, the world's largest commercial autonomous delivery system, which has flown over 140 million miles with zero safety incidents.
people.bioZh: Zipline 联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司是全球最大的商业自主配送系统，已安全飞行超过 1.4 亿英里。

episodes.tEn: From Rwanda to Global Logistics: Zipline's Journey

people.tiZh: Paper 创始人，AI 原生设计工具

people.bioZh: 斯蒂芬·哈尼是 Paper 的创始人，这是一款 AI 原生设计工具，已成为自 Figma 以来增长最快的设计工具之一。他专注于智能体优先的工作流程和 AI 驱动的设计流程。

episodes.tEn: Paper: An AI-Native Design Tool for the Next Era

people.tiEn: AI Engineer, Podcaster, Operator at Cognition
people.tiZh: AI 工程师、播客主持人、Cognition 运营者
people.bioEn: Shawn Wang, also known as Swyx, is an AI engineer, podcaster, and operator at Cognition, known for his insights into AI engineering and developer communities.
people.bioZh: 王绍恩（Swyx）是 AI 工程师、播客主持人和 Cognition 的运营者，以对 AI 工程和开发者社区的见解而闻名。

episodes.tEn: Behind Latent Space: Kill My SaaS, Jev & AI in 2026 at AIE Shanghai
AI Coding Wars and the Future of Agents

views.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
views.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的爆发点；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制、进入一切领域，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

views.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on LLMs.
views.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的 Scaling 因素；制约大模型的是记忆而非参数规模。

views.en: Own specialized models for cost and latency are rising, and open models keep gaining share even as the open-closed gap may widen.
views.zh: 为成本与延迟自研专用模型正在兴起；即便开源与闭源差距可能拉大，开源模型份额仍在上升。

views.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed: coding agents let owners clone and customize software, ushering in a golden age for SMBs and software for an audience of one.
views.zh: 中间层 SaaS 注定消亡：编程智能体让企业主能克隆并定制软件，开启中小企业与“一人受众”定制软件的黄金时代。

views.en: AI engineer is a real discipline of building harnesses around models; taste is narrowing many possibilities to the one obviously right in hindsight.
views.zh: AI 工程师是围绕模型搭建 harness 的真实学科；品味就是把众多可能快速收敛到事后看来显然正确的那一个。

people.tiZh: Waymo 联合首席执行官
people.bioEn: Dmitri Dolgov is the co-CEO of Waymo, leading the company's autonomous driving technology development and deployment.
people.bioZh: 德米特里·多尔戈夫是 Waymo 的联合首席执行官，领导公司的自动驾驶技术研发与部署。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical AI: Lessons from Waymo's Autonomous Driving

people.tiZh: Chai Discovery 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Josh Meier is the co-founder of Chai Discovery, a company applying scaling laws to drug design, with a focus on AI-driven antibody engineering.
people.bioZh: 乔什·迈尔是 Chai Discovery 的联合创始人，该公司将扩展定律应用于药物设计，专注于 AI 驱动的抗体工程。

episodes.tEn: From Serendipity to Design: Engineering Biology with AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 设计师
people.bioEn: Nate Parrott is a designer at Anthropic, known for creating Claude Design, a tool that started as a side project and became a key part of Anthropic's design workflow.
people.bioZh: 内特·帕罗特是 Anthropic 的设计师，以创建 Claude Design 而闻名，该工具最初是个人副业项目，后来成为 Anthropic 设计工作流的关键部分。

episodes.tEn: Designing with Claude: How Nate Builds Anthropic Features
Behind the Scenes of Claude Design with Nate Parrott
From Snap Engineer to Founding Designer: Nate Parrott on Designing the Arc Browser

views.en: Prototype early and follow curiosity; let individual designers leave fingerprints rather than forcing one cohesive team voice.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调尽早做原型、跟随好奇心，让设计师个人留下印记，而非强求团队统一声音。

views.en: By 2026 he treats code as the cheapest material: prototyping compressed from a year to days, so ideas and taste become the differentiator.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把代码视为最廉价的材料：原型周期从一年压缩到几天，想法与品味成为差异化关键。

views.en: He deepens a context-first method: rich context, mood boards and prescriptive prompts, then remix many options instead of polishing one.
views.zh: 他深化了“上下文优先”的方法：给足上下文、情绪板和明确指令，再混编多个选项，而非打磨单一方案。

views.en: He insists models lack taste and design thinking; humans keep a monopoly on ideas, and rough early shipping beats polish.
views.zh: 他坚持模型缺乏品味与设计思维，人类仍垄断好想法，粗糙但尽早发布胜过精雕细琢。

views.en: A consistent thread: playful tinkering, intuition balanced with data, and injecting personality into utilitarian products.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：玩味式捣鼓、直觉与数据平衡，并给实用产品注入个性与情感。

He joined Facebook in 2006, built News Feed, and later ran ads and consumer hardware before becoming CTO in 2022.
people.bioZh: 安德鲁·“Boz”·博斯沃思是 Meta 首席技术官兼 Reality Labs 负责人，统管 AI 眼镜、VR/AR 以及 Meta 押注的后移动时代硬件平台。他 2006 年加入 Facebook，主导过 News Feed，后负责广告与消费硬件业务，2022 年起任 CTO。

Giving Humans Superpowers with AI and AR
Making Meta: Andrew 'Boz' Bosworth on Building the News Feed, AR/VR, and Lessons from Facebook's Early Days

views.en: Communication is the job; transparency and top-down conviction drive impact, not bottom-up culture myths.
views.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；透明与自上而下的信念驱动影响力，而非自下而上文化的神话。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human intelligence; scaling laws alone won't yield common-sense world models.
views.zh: AI 是词语计算器，而非人类智能；仅靠缩放定律无法得到具备常识的世界模型。

views.en: Open source like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements, not just idealism.
views.zh: 像 Llama 这样的开源是让互补品商品化的战略举措，而不只是理想主义。

views.en: Smart glasses evolve into AI glasses, enabling a post-phone, embodied personal superintelligence future.
views.zh: 智能眼镜演进为 AI 眼镜，开启后手机时代、具身的个人超级智能未来。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; RL matters more.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代已结束；强化学习作用更大。

views.en: Most jobs need no frontier intelligence; avoid over-dependence on one model, and expect a hype valley.
views.zh: 多数工作不需要前沿智能；避免过度依赖单一模型，并预期炒作后的失望低谷。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates entire sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

views.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
views.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须硬核、有韧性。

views.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edge creates network effects and wins share.
views.zh: 工业级任务中专用机器人优于人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应并赢得份额。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly to audiences.
views.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今可直接面向受众发声。

views.en: In fundraising, attach to process not price; use multiple bids and demand curves, and treat real estate as part of the physical AI stack.
views.zh: 融资要依附流程而非价格；用多方竞价与需求曲线，并把房地产视为物理 AI 技术栈的一部分。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 设计是核心差异化；AI 会融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting.
views.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

views.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
views.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

views.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling.
views.zh: 设计即新代码：AI 降低生产门槛，但创意上限由人类抬高。

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
views.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must feed superintelligent models a giant prompt with context and design system.
views.zh: AI 本身不会越来越聪明；必须给超级智能模型喂上带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词。

views.en: He now writes 0% of the code; AI writes everything, so precise communication and curiosity about workflow matter most.
views.zh: 他现在 0% 的代码自己写，全由 AI 完成，因此精准沟通与对工作流的持续好奇最关键。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams—so ship imperfect work now.
views.zh: AI 是我们这代最大的技术机会，让一人做成过去一个团队的事——所以先发布不完美的作品。

views.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; VC is a trap and the safe corporate job no longer exists.
views.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点难题；融资是陷阱，安稳的朝九晚五已不复存在。

views.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
views.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是设计师保持相关性的关键。

views.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks taste.
views.zh: 设计师转变为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展与设定标准，因为 AI 抬高上限却不懂审美。

views.en: AI-built prototypes persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively.
views.zh: AI 搭建的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给 AI 智能体。

views.en: Designers should build and test in code, commit pull requests, and expose parameters like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
views.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试、提交 pull request，并用 DialKit 之类工具暴露参数来微调 AI 生成的设计。

views.en: With AI accelerating execution, ideas become the limiting factor; less is more—reduce to top three features and use native scroll.
views.zh: AI 加速执行后，想法成为瓶颈；少即是多——精简到前三个功能，并用原生滚动而非滚动劫持。

people.tiZh: Granola联合创始人兼CEO
people.bioEn: Chris Pedregal is the co-founder and CEO of Granola, an AI meeting notetaker. He previously founded Socratic, which was acquired by Google.
people.bioZh: 克里斯·佩德雷加尔是AI会议记录工具Granola的联合创始人兼CEO，此前曾创立被谷歌收购的Socratic。

The Knife Fight of AI Startups: Grainola CEO on Thriving Amid Chaos

views.en: AI is muscles; software must be bones, providing structure and context for agents via API/MCP.
views.zh: AI 是肌肉，软件必须是骨骼，通过 API/MCP 为智能体提供结构与上下文。

views.en: Pre-generating content like meeting briefs is key for timely assistance; cost is not the primary concern.
views.zh: 预生成会议简报等内容是及时辅助的关键，成本并非首要考量。

views.en: Work bifurcates into async delegation and deep collaboration; the right UI for multi-context agent work hasn't been invented.
views.zh: 工作分化为异步委派与深度协作，多上下文智能体工作的正确界面尚未被发明。

views.en: AI should augment humans, not replace them; context and accountability remain uniquely human strengths.
views.zh: AI 应增强而非取代人类，上下文与问责仍是人类独有的优势。

views.en: Don't outsource judgment to AI; engaging in judgment is uniquely human and essential.
views.zh: 不要把判断外包给 AI，亲自参与判断是人类独有且不可或缺的。

people.bioEn: Lin Qiao is the Co-founder and CEO of Fireworks AI, previously leading the PyTorch team at Meta.
people.bioZh: 乔林是Fireworks AI的联合创始人兼CEO，此前在Meta领导PyTorch团队。

episodes.tEn: Why Custom AI Models Will Replace Foundation Models, with Fireworks AI's Lin Qiao
Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model as open models and falling token costs reshape enterprise adoption.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 将主导：每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开放模型与 token 成本下降将重塑企业采用。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat after product-market fit; prompting→RAG→fine-tuning→RL mirrors human learning.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合后构筑持久护城河；从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习，对应人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习路径。

views.en: Inference quality is the bar, and private data unlocks the next frontier; customized models beat a few foundation models, with data as the real moat.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出推理质量是门槛，私有数据才能开启下一前沿；定制模型将胜过少数基础模型，数据才是真正的护城河。

views.en: Owning your model, not building on a black-box API, is the durable path; application cloning is easy, so data and model ownership matter.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：拥有自己的模型而非依赖黑盒 API 才是持久之路；应用易被复制，因此数据与模型所有权才是关键。

views.en: From millions of specialized models to post-training moats to custom models replacing foundation models: the same thesis deepens from prediction to concrete method.
views.zh: 从 2026 年“数百万专用模型”到后训练护城河，再到定制模型取代基础模型：同一论点由预测逐步深化为具体方法论。

people.bioZh: Instagram 联合创始人，后任 Anthropic 首席产品官，现为 Anthropic Labs 联合负责人，做智能体原生产品原型，并重塑工程团队围绕模型的工作方式。

views.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and let small teams scale with conceptual integrity.
views.zh: 2025 年他已判断模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，并相信小团队凭概念完整性也能扩张。

views.en: From assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker: agent-native design means anything a user can do, an agent can do.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他把 AI 从助手推向协作者乃至自主同事，提出智能体原生设计：用户能做的，智能体都能做。

views.en: The hard part shifts from writing code to deciding what to cut and verify; rewriting in days makes deletion a core skill.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，难点从写代码转向决定删什么、如何验证；几天即可重写，使“删除”成为核心能力。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation over quick chat: trust, judgment and verification loops matter more than token usage or engagement frequency.
views.zh: 2026 年中他更看重长周期委托而非快速问答：信任、判断与验证闭环，比 token 用量或使用频率更重要。

views.en: Product work is bridging human problems and technology; close the gap between model capability and real usage, preserving user agency.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：产品是连接人的问题与技术，缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，并保留用户能动性。

people.bioZh: 现负责 Anthropic 的 Claude Cowork，此前长期做 Slack 桌面端与 Electron。信奉原型优先文化：当执行成本变低，就把所有候选方案都做出来。

views.en: Claude works best with the same tools as the user, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否拿到与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

views.en: AI should absorb tedious background work; the real bottleneck is people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
views.zh: AI 应接手枯燥的后台工作；真正的瓶颈是人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI。

views.en: Fine-tuning is fast and powerful for steering behavior, while pre-training is long; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion built by context windows.
views.zh: 微调能快速有力地引导模型行为，预训练则漫长；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口造出的幻觉。

views.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools; understanding their internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
views.zh: 模型像兰花一样被养大，而非像工具一样被造出；理解其内部机制才能参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

views.en: Post-training tasks such as tool calling are migrating into pre-training, blurring boundaries; bigger models still need more context engineering.
views.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正迁入预训练，边界日益模糊；更大的模型仍需要更多上下文工程。
