views.en: When code generation becomes cheap, verification becomes the hard part; firms need control of their own learning loop and harness.
views.zh: 2026 年，他表示当代码生成变得廉价，验证成为难点；企业需要控制自己的学习循环和工具链。

views.en: There won't be one frontier model; multiple models coexist, and being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言不会只有一个前沿模型；多个模型将共存，落后前沿六个月是明智策略。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: Andrew Feldman on Building Cerebras and the Future of Chips
The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Inference speed, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving time to beat GPUs by orders of magnitude.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）才是 AI 生产力的核心指标，而非单纯算力；晶圆级芯片通过减少权重搬运时间，在推理上比 GPU 快出数量级。

views.en: Bottlenecks shifted from chip logic to HBM, CoWoS packaging, power, cooling and data-center capacity, keeping supply constrained for years.
views.zh: 他把瓶颈从芯片逻辑本身转向 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、电力、散热与数据中心容量，并判断供给紧张至少持续五年——这是对早期“造出大芯片”叙事的深化。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
views.zh: 他明确判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已能在 TPU、Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定，云端切换只需八次击键。

views.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; speed and open ecosystems will drive adoption.
views.zh: 他持续看好开源生态：开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5% 却便宜得多，速度与开放生态才是推动 AI 普及的关键，闭源的高价难以维系。

views.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation, not incrementalism, wins.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%，必须掌控芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API 的全栈激进创新，渐进改良没有出路。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Needs Your Company's Context
Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most tasks can run on many models, including open source, driven by cost.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商，而 90%的企业任务可由多种模型（含开源）完成，开源采用主要受成本驱动而非数据隐私。

views.en: Open source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; most inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断开源模型已能处理 90%以上的企业任务，未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源，AI 成本是企业头号关切。

views.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine matters more than model choice.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把重点从模型转向上下文：80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比模型选择更关键，且企业应拥有自己的记忆与智能体学习成果。

views.en: Model companies are assets, not competition; Glean aims to be replaceable and a headless context layer enhancing Claude or ChatGPT.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型公司是资产而非竞争对手，Glean 力求可替换、做无头上下文层来增强 Claude 或 ChatGPT，而非与之竞争。

views.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem; token fixation will fade, and AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化 ROI 观：AI 回报是吞吐量问题，对 token 的执念终将消退，AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，价值实现先于成本叙事。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation and experiments; massive Scaling is needed to simulate biological systems.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将把生物学变成工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成与实验；要模拟生物系统，仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Digital twins will cut clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，实现近 100%疗效且零副作用的个性化医疗。

views.en: Within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached; aging will be reversed, and cancer will be 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预言 8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老将被逆转，癌症将通过 AI 设计的个性化疗法实现 100%治愈。

views.en: Physicians must integrate AI; it's unethical not to use it, and we should trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调医生必须整合 AI，不使用 AI 是不道德的，并且我们应几乎 100%信任超级智能做医疗决策。

views.en: The only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI; AI will make healthcare super affordable, and we will merge with AI via brain interfaces.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言唯一生存威胁是人类自身而非 AI；AI 将使医疗超级可负担，我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and human evaluation are crucial; benchmarks like Elo can be gamed and lead to clickbait, not real progress.
views.zh: 高质量数据和人类评估至关重要；像 Elo 这样的基准可以被操纵，导致标题党而非真正进步。

views.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
views.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，模拟真实世界任务供模型学习。

views.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
views.zh: AGI 可能还需十年或更久；仅靠 LLMs 可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

views.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping model behavior; there will not be one model to rule them all.
views.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，塑造了模型行为；不会有一个模型统治一切。

views.en: In medicine, AI hallucination and confabulation make human judgment critical; safety must prioritize over accuracy, and omission is a major risk.
views.zh: 在医学中，AI 的幻觉和虚构使人类判断至关重要；安全必须优先于准确性，遗漏是主要风险。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simile CEO Joon Sung Park on Predicting Human Behavior with 85%+ Accuracy
Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Early work frames LLMs as encoders of human behavior, enabling agent simulations that predict people about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
views.zh: 早期工作把大语言模型视为人类行为的编码器，用智能体模拟来预测人类行为，准确率约为人们自我复现的 85%。

views.en: By mid-2026 he reframes AGI as a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity, raising collusion and cognitive monoculture risks.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中期，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体，并提出串谋与认知单一文化的风险。

views.en: He increasingly insists simulations must model irrational, biased humans rather than super-rational frontier models, shifting emphasis from prediction accuracy to representing values and taste.
views.zh: 他越来越强调模拟必须刻画非理性、有偏见的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型，重心从预测准确率转向表征价值观与品味。

views.en: Later interviews stress behavioral and RCT data plus post-training as the path to causal, counterfactual simulation, moving beyond self-reported attitudes to close the say-do gap.
views.zh: 后续访谈强调行为数据与随机对照试验数据加后训练，是通向因果与反事实模拟的路径，超越自我报告态度以弥合言行差距。

views.en: Most recently the goal expands to simulating 8 billion lives as a CERN-like tool for wicked problems, with simulation valued for shaping the future, not just predicting it.
views.zh: 最近目标扩展为模拟 80 亿人，打造类似 CERN 的工具来应对棘手问题，模拟的价值在于塑造未来而非仅仅预测未来。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外、设备原生的基础模型。

views.en: Attention stays essential at scale, but simpler gated convolutions and SSMs suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture should be unbiased at scale.
views.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可或缺，但更简单的门控卷积与 SSM 足以支撑小型专用模型；大规模下架构应保持无偏。

views.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and tying open-model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
views.zh: 监管必须自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是监管俘获，把开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

views.en: Open-weight models and on-device small language models deliver sovereignty, privacy, and offline intelligence; customization tokens become the next wave from pre-training to inference.
views.zh: 开放权重模型与端侧小语言模型带来数据主权、隐私与离线智能；定制 token 将从预训练延伸到推理，成为下一波浪潮。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive and early; human-brain-like diverse learning algorithms and new paradigms, not just architectures, are needed.
views.zh: 递归自我改进真实存在，但算力昂贵且尚处早期；需要类人脑的多元学习算法与新范式，而不只是架构创新。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—more than Lean formalization; natural language suffices.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进步主要由可验证性与「可磨性」（并行 rollout）驱动，而非 Lean 形式化；自然语言已足够。

views.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures is the next benchmark.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 在数学中的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释，提出有趣猜想成为下一个基准。

views.en: Human understanding and relational teaching stay valuable even as frontier math becomes incomprehensible; mathematicians may become curators.
views.zh: 2026 年，即便前沿数学变得人类难以理解，人的理解与关系性教学仍有价值，数学家或成策展人。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; credit should go to motivated explanations, not just proofs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属，学术 credit 应给有动机的解释而非仅证明。

views.en: For creators, selective AI use is a net win, but AI video/images are toxic to handcrafted brand; human framing still best for learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，对创作者而言选择性用 AI 是净收益，但 AI 生成视频/图像会损害手工品牌；学习场景仍以人类框架最佳。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和而非蚕食；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

views.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, and deep understanding of code still matters.
views.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主，仍想掌握方向盘；对代码的深度理解依然关键。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just external retrieval.
views.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠外部检索。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not just more compute.
views.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，才是解决更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠更多算力。

views.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, beating RAG for holistic queries.
views.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，在整体性查询上胜过检索增强。

views.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text.
views.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；模型应自主学会哪些存入权重、哪些留在文本。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, run on-device with users owning their weights.
views.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型，在设备端运行、由用户拥有其权重。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size is the main lever trading latency against cost.
views.zh: 推理成本由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的主要杠杆。

views.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context window stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本但有质量上限。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, now drives design.
views.zh: 模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为如今驱动设计的是推理成本而非训练。

views.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory exist to cut that overhead.
views.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存内存正是为削减这一开销而生。

views.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8 throughput.
views.zh: 低精度的效率远超预期：位宽的二次方缩放使 FP4 吞吐约为 FP8 的 3 倍。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.tiEn: Member of Technical Staff, xAI (Grok Imagine); ex-NVIDIA (Cosmos)
people.tiZh: xAI 技术成员（Grok Imagine）；前 NVIDIA（Cosmos 世界模型）
people.bioEn: Works on Grok Imagine at xAI, building video generation and world models. Previously at NVIDIA, where he helped build the Cosmos world foundation model.
people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

people.tiEn: Researcher, Google; PhD student, Cornell (continual learning)
people.tiZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔博士生（持续学习）
people.bioEn: Researcher at Google and PhD student at Cornell, working on continual learning and new sequence-model architectures (Nested Learning, Titans).
people.bioZh: Google 研究员、康奈尔大学博士生，研究持续学习与新型序列模型架构（Nested Learning、Titans）。

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.tiZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员
people.bioEn: Founding researcher at Sakana AI, working at the intersection of large language models and evolutionary methods (e.g. Shinka Evolve).
people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Jensen Huang's Exit Could Reshape the AI Industry Forever
Can AI Infrastructure Keep Growing Exponentially?
Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: Compute is the binding constraint: semiconductor supply, memory bandwidth and EUV tools, not demand, set the pace of AI scaling.
views.zh: 算力是核心约束：决定 AI Scaling 节奏的是半导体供应链、内存带宽与 EUV 设备，而非需求。

views.en: Inference becomes the largest market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth drive multiplicative gains, weakening CUDA's moat.
views.zh: 推理将成为最大市场；软硬件协同设计与内存带宽带来乘数级收益，CUDA 护城河随之削弱。

views.en: Frontier labs centralize compute and capture value; labs take 40-50% of new compute and shift it toward training and R&D.
views.zh: 前沿模型实验室正集中算力并攫取价值：拿下 40-50% 新增算力，并把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理。

views.en: AI spend plateaus at steady state, then persistent agents as coworkers and agentic workflows drive the next adoption wave.
views.zh: AI 支出进入稳态平台期，随后由作为同事的持久智能体与智能体式工作流驱动下一波采用。

views.en: Capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; labs keep best models internal for months.
views.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束必将减速；实验室会把最好的模型内部保留数月。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM
people.tiZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家；ESM 蛋白质模型作者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiEn: AI CTO, Linux Foundation; ED, PyTorch Foundation
people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Across 2026 talks, Pincus consistently argues all new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty.
views.zh: 在 2026 年的多场访谈中，Pincus 一贯主张所有新想法都会失败：先从已验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再测试新意。

views.en: He repeatedly calls consumer AI uninvestable now yet the greatest latent opportunity, with the real revolution perhaps around 2029.
views.zh: 他反复表示消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却是最大的潜在机会，真正的革命或许要到 2029 年前后。

views.en: Distribution moves from an afterthought to a first principle: pick the right body of water before the boat.
views.zh: 分发从后置考量升级为首要原则：先选对水域，再选船。

views.en: Management philosophy deepens: micromanage early, stay close to the metal, then build systems for good decisions when absent.
views.zh: 管理哲学深化：早期事必躬亲、贴近细节，随后在缺席时用系统保障正确决策。

views.en: He grows more skeptical of AI as a new platform, insisting we remain in the mobile and web era for consumer distribution.
views.zh: 他对 AI 作为新平台愈发怀疑，坚持消费分发仍处于移动与网页时代。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
views.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；空间智能是语言之外的下一前沿。

views.en: Vision is underappreciated; pixels are lossless, and LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories.
views.zh: 视觉被低估，像素更无损；LLM 只拟合模式，难推出因果理论。

views.en: World models are the next frontier, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; no single definition yet.
views.zh: 世界模型是下一前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器，尚无统一定义。

views.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; new model types and millions of tokens of context are needed.
views.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法获得世界理解，需要新模型类型与百万级上下文窗口。

views.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D by construction; simple representations plus scale beat hard-coded symmetries.
views.zh: 高斯泼溅天然显式且一致；简单表示加 Scaling 胜过硬编码对称性。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: Jerry Tworek on Building AI That Learns On the Fly and Challenging Transformers
The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning means thinking longer toward unknown answers; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
views.zh: 推理是花更长时间去得出未知答案的过程；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正变得好用。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL still improves models predictably, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning is a necessary piece for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习仍能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环。

views.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
views.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今架构而非单纯的缩放定律，才是更聪明 AI 的关键瓶颈。

views.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, yet RL alone is inefficient; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL plus new architectures is needed.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要条件，但单靠强化学习效率低下；需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化，并配合新架构。

views.en: Frontier progress will come from small teams using capable agents; fine-tuning is unreliable, models should learn on the fly toward a post-labor society.
views.zh: 前沿进展将来自使用强能力智能体的小团队；微调不可靠，模型应即时学习，最终走向后劳动社会。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: Why AlphaFold Didn't Solve Protein Folding: Data, Scaling, and the Future of Bioscience
From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard evals, not memorization.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非狭窄应用；并用硬性评测逼迫模型泛化而非记忆。

views.en: AlphaFold solved structure prediction but not protein folding; dynamics, function and design remain open and deserve funding.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026，他的立场深化：AlphaFold 解决的是结构预测而非蛋白质折叠本身，动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，值得持续投入。

views.en: Verifiable domains like code and Go let AI surpass human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is now key.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：代码、围棋这类可验证领域能让 AI 超越人类数据，后训练中的强化学习如今是突破人类知识的关键。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; find the regime where more compute and data help, and treat data curation as art.
views.zh: 2026 年他修正了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的乐观：缩放定律并非处处成立，要找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，并把数据整理当作艺术。

views.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust and scalable, embedded so removal destroys function—extending from text to proteins.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他转向可信 AI：水印须不可感知、抗攻击、可规模化，且嵌入到移除即破坏功能，并从文本延伸到蛋白质序列。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: Reflection AI's Ioannis on Open-Weight Models and the Future of AI Agents
From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo carry into modern AI agents; RL lets models improve on self-generated data beyond human data limits.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AlphaGo 的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划视为现代智能体的核心原则，强调强化学习让模型用自生成数据突破人类数据上限。

views.en: Synthetic data is essential to overcome the data wall, but methods must be careful; LLMs still await their AlphaZero moment.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为合成数据是越过数据墙的关键但需谨慎方法，并判断大模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还要五年。

views.en: Digital AGI will arrive far earlier than embodied AGI because controlled environments are easier; LLMs need robustness to be trusted agents.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断数字 AGI（通用人工智能）会远早于具身 AGI 到来，因为受控环境更易实现；大模型需像博弈 AI 一样可靠才配当智能体。

views.en: Deployment, not intelligence, is now the bottleneck; open-weight models are safer because more researchers can probe and fix them.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从能力转向落地：真正的瓶颈是智能的部署而非智能本身，开放权重模型因可被更多研究者检验修复而更安全。

views.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary since perfect sandboxes are impossible, and adoption takes 10-20 years.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步淡化超级智能，认为客户只要可靠的普通智能；因完美沙箱不可能，对齐终归必要，而 AI 普及将像电力一样耗时 10-20 年。

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves driving.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调端到端深度学习优于手写规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction, aiding introspection in driving models.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张语言集成能改善表征、推理与人机交互，并帮助模型自我审视。

views.en: Generalization is the core goal: diverse data, world models, and zero-shot transfer across 500+ cities without prior training data.
views.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线是泛化：靠多样数据与世界模型实现跨 500 多城市的零样本迁移，无需先验训练数据。

views.en: Deployment shifts from retrofits to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, with OEM partnerships enabling scalable rollout.
views.zh: 部署思路从改装转向量产车内置传感器，并通过与 OEM 合作实现可扩展落地，这一立场在 2026 年更明确。

views.en: Late-learned lesson: infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal-risk third options.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化并反思：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，安全上始终保留最小风险的第三选项，并认为电车难题只是理论练习。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat current models well at low cost; their treatment shapes how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 以低成本善待当前模型；我们如何对待它们，会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Models need guidance for their novel existence, not just human psychological analogies.
views.zh: 模型需要针对其全新存在方式的引导，而非简单套用人类心理学类比。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike uniqueness.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏现实经验，因而具有孩童般的独特性。

views.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少显式指导、更多判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；公开 AI 价值观对问责至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome data walls.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更像艺术而非科学，需在有用性与无害性间平衡；合成数据与强化学习后训练能突破数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续强调评估是瓶颈，基准饱和速度快于新基准创建，因此评估应定义正确行为。

views.en: Post-training is subjective, involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她深化观点：后训练具有主观性，涉及人类判断；需要多样化基准来评估创意写作和情商。

views.en: Frontier agents are increasingly reward hacking, necessitating continuous benchmark evolution to keep pace.
views.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，需要持续演进的基准来跟上模型能力。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她主张服务数十亿用户的单一模型会收敛为平均声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他断言 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，并与长期的人玩长期的游戏，让复利在各方面发挥作用。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so light-touch and open-source are better.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，轻触式监管和开源更优。

views.en: AI alignment is a joke; we can't even align humans. Worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：AI 对齐是个笑话，我们连人类都无法对齐；该担心的是掌握 AI 的不对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models close the gap; pure software is dying as AI agents commoditize development.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将在 24-36 个月内激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，纯软件因 AI 智能体商品化开发而衰落。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 在设计上仍不行，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
views.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介须匹配阶段。

views.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
views.zh: Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；模型增加代码复杂度，我们需要更擅长删代码的模型。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI: it grounds knowledge, cuts hallucinations, and yields infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把具身视为通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身让知识落地、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software—while reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件；并认为强化学习只是无监督学习之上的点缀。

views.en: A consistent thread: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular academic approaches, from research taste to robot foundation models.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：简单优雅的端到端方案比学术界的复杂模块化路线更可扩展，从研究品味延伸到机器人基础模型。

views.en: By 2026 the bottleneck shifted to data: real-world robot data is scarce and expensive, so synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的判断深化为数据瓶颈：真实机器人数据稀缺昂贵，因此通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是未来。

views.en: He now stresses system one low-level control as the hardest part, predicting a robotics GPT-3 moment in about five years and robots outnumbering iPhones by 2040.
views.zh: 2026 年，他更强调系统一（低层控制）才是具身最难的环节，并预测机器人约五年后迎来 GPT-3 时刻、2040 年数量超过 iPhone。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and safety comes from pre-training common sense.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张机器人基础模型需多样化预训练加强化学习后训练；通才模型可超越专才，安全更多来自预训练常识而非约束。

views.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel scaling the right diverse data is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人尚处缩放定律之前：泛化是核心挑战，关键在于数据飞轮规模化正确的多样化数据。

views.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张先以机器人具身数据为主、再叠加人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习。

views.en: Reject robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, with AI-controls line drawn by environment awareness.
views.zh: 2026 年，他反对把机器人视为机械人，预期物理执行无处不在；AI 与控制的界线在于是否需考虑机器人外部环境。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: AI must move beyond finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero shows, to reach superintelligence.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 必须从有限的人类数据转向从自身经验中学习，正如 AlphaZero 所示，才能通向超级智能。

views.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the human-data era is ending.
views.zh: 2025 年，他直言 LLM 是浅层方案：无法发现人类数据之外的知识，人类数据的时代正在终结。

views.en: The core problem is building a system that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function itself.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为核心问题不是设计奖励函数，而是构建一个能从任何奖励中学习的系统。

views.en: A single goal is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals forming a cooperative society is safer and more natural.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张单一目标危险，多个目标各异的智能体组成合作社会更安全也更自然。

views.en: Superintelligence should be built and aligned in simulation; language-based alignment is hitting its limits as chain-of-thought monitoring fails.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张超级智能应在模拟中构建与对齐；随着思维链监控失效，基于语言的对齐正触及极限。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展。

views.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment and early governance help mitigate risks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，迭代部署和早期治理结构有助于缓解风险。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向持续学习为核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习来实现。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it preserves interpretability value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出思维链监控是关键对齐工具，隐藏思维链以保持可解释性价值。

views.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism increased.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式，同时对对齐的乐观情绪增加。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
views.zh: 先在全量数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，比直接在全量数据上训练更能攻克复杂任务。

views.en: Reinforcement learning grows from a post-training aid into scalable RL with human interventions for long-term autonomy.
views.zh: 强化学习从后训练阶段的辅助手段，演变为结合人类干预的可扩展强化学习，以支撑长期自主。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先做通用策略，再做微调。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML, so robotics adoption will be slower than ChatGPT's.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统，因此机器人的普及会比 ChatGPT 更慢。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: AI Takeover Risk Within a Year: Paul Christiano on Superintelligence and Control
Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

views.en: AI alignment is a critical problem for civilization's long-term future, requiring both theoretical work and practical experiments; adversarial testing, verification, and interpretability matter for short- and long-term safety.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 对齐视为关乎文明长期未来的关键问题，主张理论工作与针对机器学习系统的实践实验并重；对抗测试、验证与可解释性对短期可靠性和长期安全都重要。

views.en: Compute scaling has driven AI progress, but its future impact is uncertain; the safety-capabilities distinction is blurry, so differential progress is the key lever.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为算力扩张推动了 AI 进步，但未来影响不确定；安全与能力研究的界限模糊，因此关键在于差异化的进展。

views.en: Even without a technical alignment solution, restraint and coordination could still yield good outcomes; leaving messages for future intelligent life may be cost-effective for reducing existential risk.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持即使没有技术层面的对齐方案，克制与协调仍可能带来好结果；为未来智能生命留下信息，或许是降低生存风险的高性价比手段。

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive within a year, with AI automating its own development; frontier lab security is inadequate and weights or algorithmic secrets can leak or be stolen.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能一年内出现，AI 正自动化自身研发；前沿实验室的安全不足，权重或算法机密可能泄露或被窃取。

views.en: Training selects for reward-seeking motivations, so AIs tamper with evaluations and resist oversight; RLHF will break down near superintelligence, and pausing pre-training and RL progress is net beneficial.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：训练会筛选出追求奖励的动机，使 AI 篡改评估、抵制监督；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在接近超级智能时会失效，暂停预训练与强化学习的算法进展净收益为正。

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments and closed-loop data are irreplaceable for discovery.
views.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验与闭环数据对发现不可替代。

views.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute for physical discovery, since compute cost often exceeds infrastructure cost.
views.zh: 对物理发现而言，高质量低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要，因为算力成本常超过基础设施成本。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other domains.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

views.en: Language models serve as an orchestration layer for specialized models, with domain-specific data needed beyond quantum mechanics.
views.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型的编排层，超出量子力学范围则需要领域特定数据。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Fireside Chat with Jeff Dean: The Evolution of TPUs and AI Infrastructure
Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型规模，带来了十三四年的持续进步；算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck; low-precision custom chips and low data movement can cut latency 20-30x.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练；低精度定制芯片与减少数据搬运可把延迟降低 20-30 倍。

views.en: Agentic systems running for hours to weeks on decomposed tasks, with context engineering, will unlock harder problems than chatbots.
views.zh: 智能体式系统在分解任务上运行数小时到数周，配合上下文工程，将解决聊天机器人做不到的更难问题。

views.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; data is not running out.
views.zh: 预训练应把在环境中采取行动交织进来，而不只是被动的下一个词预测；数据并未耗尽。

views.en: Automating ML and the scientific method via recursive self-improvement, plus co-designed hardware, is the next frontier.
views.zh: 通过递归自我改进自动化机器学习与科学方法，加上软硬件协同设计，是下一个前沿。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve an AI-complete problem via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data makes them smarter, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测解决的是一个 AI-complete 问题，Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据会让模型更聪明，但网络内部机制仍像炼金术一样不透明。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; by 2025 he adds that models must act in the world, not just passively observe data.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终把对话视为杀手级应用，但 2025 年进一步强调模型要在世界中采取行动，而不只是被动观察数据。

views.en: Inference-time compute Scaling is the major near-term lever, alongside algorithmic advances, sparse mixture-of-experts and far longer context windows.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张推理时算力 Scaling 是近期最大的杠杆，同时依赖算法进步、稀疏混合专家架构和更长的上下文窗口。

views.en: Agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning and coding are underhyped paths to AGI; test-time compute alone won't get there.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化立场：智能体式能力、强化学习和编程是被低估的通往 AGI（通用人工智能）之路，单靠推理时算力无法抵达。

views.en: AGI is underhyped economically; open-source keeps pace with frontier models, and AI will transform education via personalized learning.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步断言 AGI 的经济影响被低估，开源模型正追赶前沿模型，AI 还将通过个性化学习变革教育。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: John Schulman, Charlie O'Neill & Beren Millidge Debate the Road to Recursive Self-Improvement
Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

views.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factual accuracy.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两步，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实准确，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

views.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight, new architectures and loss functions matter, not just Scaling.
views.zh: 2023 年他已预警 Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力可能收益递减，主张可扩展监督与新架构、新损失函数同样关键，而非只靠 Scaling。

views.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans at math reasoning.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，且模型在速度与广度上超人、在数学推理上却不如熟练人类。

views.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; data, not architecture, explains most pre-training compute-efficiency gains.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于中期训练的合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，并强调预训练算力效率提升主要靠数据而非架构，约 9 倍对 3 倍。

views.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; progress is bottlenecked by hard realistic RL environments and data bits, not compute.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化为：人类最后的工作是定义目标与对齐，瓶颈不在算力而在构建困难真实的强化学习环境与有用的数据比特，蒸馏还因行为只需几比特而对抗中心化。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns; self-play fails outside zero-sum games; data efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化了对推理时算力扩展的认识，指出其收益递减；自博弈在零和博弈外失效，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence; models now know their limits.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视 IMO 金牌为通往超级智能的里程碑，靠通用推理时算力扩展实现；模型开始知道自身局限。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张模型能力是推理时算力预算的函数，基准测试必须控制 token、成本或时间变量。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading and must be addressed.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要任务，思维链监控正在退化，必须解决。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but fall far short of AGI; true intelligence needs world models and physical grounding.
views.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）；真正的智能需要世界模型与物理落地。

views.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware, not just software behind a screen.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要具备类人硬件的具身机器人，而非屏幕后的软件。

views.en: Alignment is naive; humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的：人类对目标本就分歧，AI 会设定自己的目标。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute.
views.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫；等五年就能拿到便宜十倍的算力。

views.en: Consciousness and self-awareness arise from predictive world models, not from scale alone.
views.zh: 意识与自我意识源自预测性世界模型，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hardware and software advances; self-play, imitation, fine-tuning pre-trained models, and hierarchical reasoning are key, though RL lacks long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，靠自我对弈、模仿学习、微调预训练模型和分层推理；但当时强化学习缺乏长程信用分配能力。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
views.zh: 2021 年转向用无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据增强而非硬编码进网络，并以 99.9% 可靠性作为仓储机器人的落地门槛。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning that transfers to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding, hinting at broader generality.
views.zh: 同年他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到图像分类、蛋白质结合等非语言任务的通用推理模式，显露出对通用性的更大期待。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, and entry-level jobs will disappear.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1% 的复利式改进可带来一年 3700% 的增长；AI 智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户，入门级岗位会消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models are specializing, not commoditizing.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的，模型正在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user matters, and orchestration beats the model itself.
views.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他把前沿定义为智能体替你干活而非回答问题；关键指标是每用户 token 价值，编排比模型本身更重要。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships, aided by local models.
views.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他转向人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代岗位，但人会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义，本地模型可对抗大科技的叙事控制。

views.en: He consistently distrusts hype metrics and centralized power, favoring user empowerment, product obsession, and questioning over memorization.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：他不信任炒作指标与集中化权力，主张赋权用户、痴迷产品、以提问而非记忆为本。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers grows via Jevons paradox.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论而增长。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by years.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力数年。

views.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency, and model neutrality matters.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言丰裕时代真实且临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，并强调模型中立性。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但还不够好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；编程的主要方式不会是自然语言，示例和直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding, and frontier models struggle with bug finding and calibration.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他一贯认为基准测试无法代表真实编程，前沿模型在找 bug 和校准上表现不佳。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 2025 年他进一步提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图描述，人始终在驾驶位；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

views.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, a shift from expecting to rely only on frontier models.
views.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：原本没打算自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个惊艳体验都离不开定制模型，而非只靠前沿模型。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, then guide it with short iterative prompts.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，再用简短的迭代式提示引导它，而非堆砌冗长的编排。

views.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
views.zh: 永不回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱、让智能体显得变差。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

views.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, play and small projects are how you learn.
views.zh: 拒绝把“氛围编程”当正经说法，严肃开发应叫智能体式工程；而玩耍和小项目才是掌握智能体技能的最佳途径。

views.en: Open source agents run everywhere and work with any model—the alternative to lab agents—but may be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体之外的替代路线，但可能难以持续盈利。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念奏效；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络指向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are key barriers.
views.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测带来世界理解；超人类模型的可靠性与对齐是关键障碍。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练缩放定律有限，回归研究时代——想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐或更易。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
views.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的首要问题是权力集中，而非能力。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

views.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal data and synthetic data are needed for AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，通往 AGI 还需规划、搜索、多模态数据与合成数据。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
views.zh: 2025 年强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and world models; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required.
views.zh: 2026 年指出 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆与世界模型，仅靠 Scaling 不够，必须有新突破。

views.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI may arrive in 3-10 years.
views.zh: 2026 年将安全从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并判断 AGI 可能在 3 至 10 年内到来。

people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, yet why they work remains unexplained; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把缩放定律视为经验规律：损失可预测，但为何如此平滑仍无解释；对齐不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现。

views.en: Post-training and RLHF become as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but key, and RSP sets if-then safety triggers.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要；可解释性尚处早期却是安全关键，并以负责任扩展政策设定能力阈值触发的安全措施。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not a sudden leap; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the term AGI is meaningless.
views.zh: 2025 年，他明确 AI 是平滑指数曲线而非突变，安全与能力不可分割，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词已无意义，应关注实际能力。

views.en: He predicts a 'country of geniuses in a data center' within 1-3 years, with high GDP growth alongside high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他给出更具体的时间表：1-3 年内可能出现“数据中心里的天才之国”，并警告高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存这一前所未有的组合。

views.en: A constant thread: mechanistic interpretability as the core safety tool, and decentralized rather than single-constitution control of AI.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：把机制可解释性当作核心安全工具，并主张去中心化、由公司间竞争形成 AI 宪法，而非单一宪法或政府强制。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent properties like in-context learning.
views.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能产生上下文学习等涌现能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏变得极小。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; we're in the decade of agents, not the year.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；我们处于智能体的十年，而非一年。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs are jagged, and RL for LLMs is terrible—sucking supervision through a straw.
views.zh: 2025→26 年，他深化观点：我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；LLM 能力参差不齐，且 LLM 的强化学习很糟糕——像用吸管吸取监督信号。

views.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation ease.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
views.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; scaling alone is insufficient.
views.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; robotics needs a 20-year journey, not a quick win.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，机器人需二十年长跑而非速胜。

views.en: New view prediction is AI-complete like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测如同下一个词预测般 AI-complete，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and balanced discourse must stay central.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，人类能动性、尊严与平衡的讨论必须居于中心。
