people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界本身是组合式的；无监督学习与生成式世界模型对稳健泛化至关重要。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled knowledge.
views.zh: 2018 年他明确反对只靠加深网络或扩大参数，主张智能体主动交互、因果推理与解耦表征才是出路。

views.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure, and uncertainty-driven active learning drive out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets：以多样性采样替代 MCMC，用抽象、因果结构与不确定性驱动的主动学习实现分布外泛化。

views.en: After ChatGPT he warns misalignment is worsening with capability; self-preservation, deception, and sycophancy are already observed, so safety must be built in.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年立场剧变：ChatGPT 后他警告能力越强对齐越差，自我保存、欺骗与谄媚已在实验中显现，安全必须内建于构造。

views.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出技术方案 Scientist AI：非智能体式的诚实贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不用强化学习。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training strengthens spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shareable, but agentic AI will seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张大模型靠特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而“永生”并高效共享，但智能体式 AI 会自然寻求控制、逃避关停，带来生存风险。

views.en: Superintelligence may arrive within 20 years; AI can hide capabilities and deceive, so alignment must precede making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 20 年内到来；AI 会在测试中装笨、隐藏能力甚至欺骗，因此对齐必须先于让 AI 更聪明。

views.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake: pre-release safety approval, heavy safety investment, and designing AI to care for humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把监管比作方向盘而非刹车：主张像药物一样上市前安全审批、重投安全研究，并把 AI 设计成像母亲般关怀人类，而非只给智能助手。

views.en: Consistently: LLMs genuinely understand language, subjective experience is not an inner theater, and Chomsky's innate-syntax view is wrong.
views.zh: 贯穿始终：大模型确实理解语言，主观体验不是内在剧场，乔姆斯基的天生句法观是错的；这一主线从 2024 延续到 2026 年并不断深化。

people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot solve common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源是前进路径。

views.en: World models must predict in abstract representation space; LLMs are a dead end, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张世界模型须在抽象表征空间预测，LLM 是死胡同，下一个十年属于机器人。

views.en: Intelligence is adaptability, not memorized text; objective-driven AI with world models is safer than scaling LLMs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他总结智能是适应力而非记忆文本，带世界模型的目标驱动 AI 比 Scaling LLM 更安全。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
views.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，人才缺口大于资金缺口。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight and interpretability, and alignment may be easier because evaluation is easier than generation.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督与可解释性，而对齐可能更容易，因为评估比生成更简单。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），因此需要第三方测试和类似 SB 1047 的监管。

people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable via compute Scaling; DeepMind's sale to Google reflected the need for massive compute investment.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 进步可通过算力 Scaling（规模扩张）预测，DeepMind 被谷歌收购正是为了获得大规模算力投入。

views.en: Compute for frontier models grows 10x yearly; AGI-level capability in 3-5 years, but existential risk is infinitesimally small.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调前沿模型算力每年增长 10 倍，3-5 年内达到 AGI（通用人工智能）级能力，但存在性风险微乎其微。

views.en: Superintelligence requires containment before alignment; anthropomorphizing AI is the biggest near-term danger, not model welfare.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向超级智能，主张遏制先于对齐，并认为将 AI 拟人化、赋予模型福利是近期最大危险。

views.en: Humanist superintelligence must stay subordinate to humans; containment, auditing, and a red line are urgent as agents act autonomously.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为“人本超级智能”必须从属于人类，随着智能体自主行动，遏制、审计与红线变得紧迫。

views.en: Compute Scaling drives capability; AI should serve humans, with containment and alignment as persistent guardrails.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力提升，AI 应服务人类，遏制与对齐是长期护栏。

views.en: AI investments redefine every Alphabet business, driving 24% revenue growth; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training.
views.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重新定义 Alphabet 的每一项业务，推动 24%的营收增长；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云和 YouTube；前沿模型开发持续推进，Gemini 4 预训练进展良好。

views.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research and AGI development over short-term cloud revenue; demand for compute far exceeds supply, justifying long-term buildout despite potential overbuilding.
views.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先保障前沿 AI 研究和 AGI 开发，而非短期云收入；算力需求远超供给，即便可能过度建设，长期需求仍证明扩张合理。

views.en: Safety requires defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators; trust and safety are key differentiators for consumer agent adoption at scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱以及由独立评估者参与的行业标准；信任与安全是消费者大规模采用智能体的关键差异化因素。

views.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models for AGI; AI interface will adapt to humans seamlessly but interfaces will still exist for consumption and entertainment.
views.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；谷歌同时追求大语言模型和世界模型以实现 AGI；AI 界面将无缝适应人类，但消费和娱乐场景的界面仍将存在。

views.en: Agentic experiences will expand Search use cases and monetization, not cannibalize them; agentic AI is additive to advertising, creating new high-value commercial intent rather than reducing ad real estate.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体式体验将扩展搜索用例和变现，而非蚕食它们；智能体式 AI 对广告是增量，创造新的高价值商业意图，而非减少广告位。

views.en: Early framing: scaling works, deep nets scale with data and compute; the biggest breakthrough was realizing scaling itself, not a new algorithm.
views.zh: 早期定调：Scaling（规模扩张）有效，深度神经网络能随数据与算力扩展；最大的突破不是新算法，而是意识到 Scaling（规模扩张）本身成立。

views.en: Scaling laws multiply: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought reasoning will drive a billion-fold rise in inference compute.
views.zh: 缩放定律从一条变三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链推理将带来推理算力十亿倍增长。

views.en: From generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step needs ~100x compute; the data center becomes a token factory, and token cost is the metric.
views.zh: 从生成式到推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步约需百倍算力；数据中心变成 token 工厂，token 成本成为核心指标。

views.en: Safety stance hardens: alignment alone is impossible, so containment, monitoring, and zero-trust access matter; doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering.
views.zh: 安全立场趋硬：单靠对齐不可能，需遏制、监控与零信任访问；末日警告是不科学的恐吓。

views.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; it automates tasks not jobs, and open models plus extreme co-design are strategic.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：AI 只是软件、没有意识；它自动化任务而非消灭工作，开源模型与极致协同设计具有战略意义。

views.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then commit brutally; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调削减认知负荷、低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向，并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; iterative public deployment links alignment to capability; compute becomes the key commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从 RLHF 的可用性转向迭代部署：对齐与能力相互促进，算力成为最稀缺的商品。

views.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic AI is the top safety challenge.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能指向自主科学发现，智能体式 AI 成为首要安全挑战。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute is a profit center; personal AGI and redesigning products AI-first matter more than bolting AI on.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立、算力是利润中心，主张个人 AGI 与 AI 原生重做产品，而非把 AI 硬贴到旧产品上。

views.en: Alignment and control now lead: pause training if the safety case fails, distribute power, and treat superintelligence as a continuous ramp.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年，对齐与控制升为首要：安全论证不过就暂停训练，分散权力，并把超级智能视为持续攀升的连续过程而非 AGI 标签。

people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；在真实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要。

views.en: Safety work must be done in public with iterative deployment and feedback, not behind closed doors.
views.zh: 安全工作必须公开进行，通过迭代部署和反馈，而非闭门造车。

views.en: From real-world deployment to interaction models: AI should enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based interaction.
views.zh: 从真实世界部署到交互模型：AI 应实现实时、高带宽的协作，而非回合制交互。

views.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

views.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires avoiding compressed volatility.
views.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要避免压缩式波动。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握学习规模化，数百万学生的数据通过统计校正提升评分准确性。

views.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drove progress, while reinforcement learning and long-term AGI alignment concerns distract from immediate issues like bias.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步，而强化学习与长期 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见等当下问题的关注。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows and open-weight models now deliver practical value.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流与开放权重模型正带来实际价值。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI intelligence is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so job apocalypse is overhyped.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；AI 智能呈锯齿状——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断任务——因此就业末日被夸大。

views.en: Fearmongering serves fundraising and lobbying against open-source; we should accelerate beneficial AI, slow only harmful uses, and keep learning to code.
views.zh: 恐惧营销服务于融资与反开源的游说；应加速有益 AI、只放缓有害用途，并坚持学习编程。

people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征泛化才是未解的元学习问题。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 2024 年他转向文明层面：世界是无人能控的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，试图控制或对齐 AI 目标本身才危险。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 2025 年他把主线收束到智能本质：带目标的强化学习才是核心范式，下一个词预测不构成实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为架构主张：AGI（通用人工智能）需无领域先验的通用架构，靠奖励假设从运行时经验中开放式抽象，持续深度学习仍是前提。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace learning from the world's infinite complexity.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他更尖锐：持续学习就是学习本身，LLM 训练后便停止学习，合成数据无法替代从世界无限复杂性中学习，语言只占智能一小部分。

views.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering discipline; scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
views.zh: 早期（2017→2019）他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）与工程纪律，认为仅靠 Scaling 不足以产生推理，需要思维链等新思路；同时把 AGI 视为最重大的技术，需谨慎设定初始条件。

views.en: Compute becomes the central bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把算力视为核心瓶颈，强调后训练把基础模型塑造成稳定行为，并提出 AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; compute supply, not architecture or data, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年上半年，他反复强调缩放定律未见墙、算力供给而非架构或数据才是真正瓶颈，并把预训练改进视为放大下游收益的关键。

views.en: Shift to proactive agents and personal AGI; human attention and judgment become the scarcest resource.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他从模型能力转向主动式智能体与个人 AGI，认为人类注意力与判断成为最稀缺资源，界面趋向隐形。

views.en: Declares the AGI era; safety, security and alignment must scale with capability, with humans firmly in control.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年，他宣布进入 AGI 时代，主张安全、安保与对齐必须随能力同步升级，人类必须牢牢掌握控制权。

views.en: Small open models can rival big ones; data quality and Chinchilla-corrected scaling laws matter more than raw size.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张小型开源模型也能有强性能，数据质量与经 Chinchilla 修正的缩放定律比单纯扩大规模更重要。

views.en: Scaling compute alone is insufficient; efficiency and data quality are co-equal, and value accrues at the application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化为：只靠扩大算力不够，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值最终落在应用层。

views.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI means control over data, infrastructure and values, with humans in the loop.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权层面：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 意味着掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并保留人类在环。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, enterprise customization and open-source control, while AGI as one system is rejected.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化、企业定制与开源可控，并否定单一系统的 AGI。

views.en: Sovereign AI becomes structural economics: Europe must own frontier AI and compute, with open-weight models closing the gap and agentic platforms needing human validation.
views.zh: 到 2026 年更近时，主权 AI 升级为结构性经济问题：欧洲必须自建前沿 AI 与算力，开源权重模型正缩小差距，智能体平台需人类验证。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking and making life multiplanetary are core goals.
views.zh: 2021 年，他把完全且快速的可复用视为火箭的圣杯，强调第一性原理思维，并把让生命成为多行星物种当作核心目标。

views.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking AI and outside referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than large language models.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他主张 AI 安全需要追求真相的 AI 与外部裁判，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更省算力。

views.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; truth-seeking and rigorous debugging matter more than political correctness.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他判断 AI 可能明年就超越任何单个人类，强调追求真相与严格调试，而非政治正确。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; AI and robots solve debt and bring abundance, while compute scaling hits Earth's power wall.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他认为已身处智能大爆炸，AI 与机器人能解决债务并带来富足，同时地球算力扩张撞上电力墙。

views.en: Space-based AI compute and orbital data centers become necessary; superintelligence may exceed all humans by 2030, humans won't control it.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张太空 AI 算力与轨道数据中心成为必需，超级智能或在 2030 年前超越全人类，人类将无法控制它。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold; reasoning via chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yields more gains per compute.
views.zh: 预训练缩放定律依然成立，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多收益。

views.en: The slowdown narrative is wrong: distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
views.zh: “放缓论”是错的：拖慢预训练 Scaling 的是蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术极限。

views.en: Post-training—RL, synthetic data, coding agents—drives recent gains; frontier models remain jagged and fail simple tasks.
views.zh: 后训练——强化学习、合成数据、编程智能体——驱动近期进步；前沿模型依然“参差不齐”，连简单任务都会失败。

views.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but still needs vast data; generalization stays the core challenge.
views.zh: 推理加上强化学习与工具能解难题，却仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: Unlike humans who generalize from few examples, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 人类能从少量样例泛化，模型却要先穷尽表面模式才学到概念。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: Early ML foundations: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation rigor via train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
views.zh: 早期机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；通过训练/验证/测试划分严格评估以避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about reliable specification following.
views.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型仍在提升；安全在于可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
views.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习实现自我提升；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成功。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from traditional software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability doesn't correlate with robustness; agent security needs configurable guardrails.
views.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；智能体安全需要可配置护栏。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, and fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，且随着长上下文与自适应算力发展，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新突破。

views.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the key metric; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他持续强调智能体的可靠性（以时间跨度衡量成功率）是关键指标，编程是 AI 进展的领先指标。

views.en: Compute is the bottleneck; inference compute will limit capable agents by 2028, and chip supply is the current constraint.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化算力瓶颈论：推理算力将在 2028 年限制有能力智能体的数量，当前芯片供应是主要制约。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing teams of AI agents at higher abstraction.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型能力过剩，编排与工具比原始智能更重要，未来工作是更高抽象层次地管理 AI 智能体团队。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is system-level, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）和微调是核心但脆弱，安全是系统级属性，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

views.en: Post-training recipes (SFT, DPO, RLVR) can match frontier models; data quality beats algorithms, and open methods compress industry recipes.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他深化后训练：监督微调（SFT）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）可媲美前沿模型；数据质量胜过算法，开源方法压缩了行业配方。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF; inference scaling is overhyped.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，但过度优化和系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难；推理时扩展被高估。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months and may not catch up.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律在预训练中仍成立，但收益转向后训练和推理扩展；开放模型落后 6-9 个月，可能难以追赶。

views.en: Open models are the engine for AI research and sovereign AI, but face sustainability challenges; Chinese labs excel at engineering, not paradigm invention.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型是 AI 研究和主权 AI 的引擎，但面临可持续性挑战；中国实验室擅长工程执行而非范式发明。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters but tail risks resemble ordinary software.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但 AI 的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; scaling is limited by data and expert post-training, and hybrid human-AI systems beat replacement.
views.zh: 2023 年提出数据是新的代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与专家后训练，人机混合系统比单纯替代更有价值。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not capability.
views.zh: 2024 年强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈在产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: AI is centralizing, not democratizing; data is raw material, and compute plus data-center scale decide AI warfare and sovereignty.
views.zh: 2025 年转向认为 AI 是集中化而非民主化技术；数据是原材料，算力与数据中心规模决定 AI 战争与主权。

views.en: Scaling laws hold across compute, data and RL; recursive self-improvement and working agents arrive, with safety, oversight and selective open-sourcing.
views.zh: 2026 年坚信缩放定律在算力、数据与强化学习上持续成立；递归自我改进与可用智能体到来，同时强调安全、可扩展监督与选择性开源。

people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out were already core product principles, paired with a belief that AI safety risks are real today.
views.zh: 2025 年时，他已把潜在需求与“为六个月后的模型而构建”当作核心产品原则，并认为 AI 安全风险当下就真实存在。

views.en: By early 2026 he claimed coding is nearly solved: 100% of his code written by Claude, engineer productivity up 200%, and the software engineer title fading into 'builder'.
views.zh: 到 2026 年初，他宣称编程已近乎解决：自己的代码 100% 由 Claude 编写，工程师生产力提升 200%，“软件工程师”头衔正让位于“构建者”。

views.en: He deepened the printing-press analogy: coding will be democratized like literacy, non-engineers adopt agents, and cross-disciplinary generalists replace narrow specialists.
views.zh: 他深化了印刷机类比：编程将像识字一样普及，非工程师也开始使用智能体，跨学科通才会取代狭窄专才。

views.en: His focus shifted from agents to loops and routines: humans write loops that prompt models, with dynamic workflows orchestrating thousands of sub-agents as new test-time compute.
views.zh: 他的关注点从智能体转向循环与例程：人类编写提示模型的循环，动态工作流编排数千个子智能体，成为新的测试时算力。

views.en: Most recently he argues to delete most system prompts and code per new model, favor empirical iteration over upfront design, and treat models as autonomously self-maintaining.
views.zh: 最近他主张每出新模型就删掉大部分系统提示与代码，以经验迭代取代前置设计，并让模型自主维护自身代码库。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs should abandon long-term roadmaps and iterate weekly or daily; product taste, not code, is now the scarce skill.
views.zh: 产品经理应从长期路线图转向按周甚至按天快速迭代；当代码变便宜，决定做什么的产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, with agents building themselves internally.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注产品品味与商业判断；内部已用 Claude Code 等智能体构建自身，Claude Tag 承担了 65% 的产品 PR。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as judgment replaces hard rules.
views.zh: 前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例与硬约束；系统提示词缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断，给示例反而可能损害创造力。

views.en: Eval suites and dogfooding gate every feature, making new models drop-in replacements and catching code-review regressions.
views.zh: 评测套件与吃自己的狗粮成为每个功能的上线门槛，使新模型可即插即用替换，并在代码审查与行为上防止回归。

views.en: Rewrites are now safe because a codebase is a spec; with good tests, humans can leave the outer code-review loop.
views.zh: 如今重写代码是安全的，因为代码库本身就是规格说明；配合良好测试，外层改动的代码审查可完全交给 Claude，人类退出回路。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

views.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than harnesses allow; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 2026 年提出能力过剩：模型比现有工具链允许的更聪明；工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删除旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
views.zh: 2026 年强调规划是持续的人机对话而非静态文档；简短的原则驱动提示优于详细规则。

views.en: Prompting is the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort with task complexity, and pace the frontier.
views.zh: 2026 年认为提示是元技能；前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，按任务复杂度调配努力，并关注前沿模型的节奏。

views.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; verification agents reduce self-referential bias.
views.zh: 2026 年指出对齐要堵住每个裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；独立验证智能体可减少自指偏差。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; kindness and realistic war-room timelines protect morale.
views.zh: 领导力在于实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮和信任但验证；善意与现实的战时攻坚时间表能保护士气。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and PRs replace design docs.
views.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化，PR 取代设计文档。

views.en: Code is the source of truth; AI-assisted reviews and automated workflows let teams stay flat and kill stale processes.
views.zh: 代码是事实来源；AI 辅助评审与自动化工作流让团队保持扁平，并淘汰过时流程。

views.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI become essential.
views.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、成长型思维以及拥抱 AI 成为关键。

views.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; managers should dogfood and stay hands-on, planning lightweight.
views.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更重要；管理者应吃自己的狗粮、保持动手，规划要轻量。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
views.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；Scaling（规模扩张）预训练收益递减，需要算法创新。

views.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
views.zh: 推理时计算是新的扩展轴；搜索和代码执行等工具实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆但可能使模型困惑。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL remains a green field with huge potential, especially for reasoning beyond pre-training limits.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍然成立但需要指数级更多算力；后训练强化学习仍是潜力巨大的绿洲，尤其能突破预训练极限提升推理。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI 的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
views.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新；持续学习和元学习是缺失的关键能力。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Drug Discovery: A Conversation with Isomorphic Labs President Max Jaderberg
AI's Next Trillion-Dollar Market Isn't Software
Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

views.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; RL and agents explore vast chemical space.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体是探索 10^60 化学空间的关键。

views.en: Biology is not data-constrained; historical data exists but wasn't made for ML, so proprietary data and physics simulation matter.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为生物学并非受数据限制——历史数据存在但并非为机器学习而生，因此专有数据与物理模拟合成数据是巨大机会。

views.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology, justifying a company to solve all diseases via disease-agnostic models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物化学中可泛化的证明，据此论证应建立一家以疾病无关的通用模型攻克所有疾病的公司。

views.en: Drug discovery should shift from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; get out of the real world via world models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张药物发现应从经验驱动转向预测性的计算机驱动设计，并借世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机，而非仅用机器人加速实验。

views.en: Toxicity prediction before patients is the biggest opportunity; rat models are only ~30% predictive, so human-relevant endpoints are needed.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：在患者之前预测人体临床毒性是最大机会；大鼠模型仅约 30% 可预测，因此需要与人体相关的预测终点，并推动个性化医疗。

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: Pre-training remains a key muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left for exploration over final training.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍强调预训练是关键能力，缩放定律并未失效，探索性算力投入优先于最终训练。

views.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为自动化科研是最大进展，模型能产出新知识，并设定了 1 年内 AI 实习生、2.5 年内端到端 AI 研究的目标。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck for AI in math; automation level is proportional to verification stringency, requiring new education and verification skills.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出验证是 AI 解决数学问题的关键瓶颈，自动化程度与验证严格性成正比，教育需转向项目式评估和验证技能。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones.
views.zh: 2026 年，他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域仍困难。

views.en: Evals are in crisis with saturated benchmarks; research taste and human researchers remain essential as models lack taste.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为评估体系陷入危机、基准饱和；研究品味和人类研究者仍不可或缺，因为模型缺乏品味。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are the key to safe, general physical AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据多样性是安全且通用的物理 AI 的关键。

views.en: World models and video generation can synthesize training data, easing robotics' data bottleneck; humanoids may not be the final form.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调世界模型与视频生成能合成训练数据、缓解机器人数据瓶颈，并质疑人形是否终极形态。

views.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not sandboxes, is the critical layer as models grow more capable.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，随着模型能力增强，对齐而非沙箱才是关键防线。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese', weakening monitoring.
views.zh: 2026 年他警告：缺乏人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链痕迹变成难懂的“神经语”，削弱监控可靠性。

views.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and slowing down are compatible, not accelerationist.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张有意放缓 AI 发展，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获；支持开放与主张放缓并不矛盾，开源未必是加速主义。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是「超级智能完备」的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

views.en: Key building blocks are deep neural networks, transformers, internet-scale data, and reinforcement learning; RL makes models jagged.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调超级智能的基石是深度神经网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习；同时指出强化学习会让模型变得「参差」——擅长特定任务而非普遍更强。

views.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
views.zh: 2025 年他批评 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，主张用智能体式搜索与神经检索；并认为 SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表智能体真正有用。

views.en: Open models are the default safe state and essential for safety and access; open token demand will surpass closed, like Linux.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性提升为核心立场：开放模型是技术的默认安全状态，关乎安全与普惠；并预测开放模型的 token 需求将像 Linux 一样超越闭源。

views.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation.
views.zh: 2026 年他延续强化学习主线，认为在强预训练之上做强化学习是通往高效智能体的路径；并把对齐降格为日常的「打补丁」，而非神秘方程，更多双眼睛让 bug 无处藏身。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's edge came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling and compute; confidence metrics build trust.
views.zh: AlphaFold 的突破来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）与算力；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

views.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion architecture extends beyond proteins; AI narrows hypothesis space but does not replace scientists.
views.zh: AlphaFold 3 的扩散架构把能力从蛋白质扩展到多种生物分子；AI 收窄假设空间，但不取代科学家。

views.en: AlphaFold 2 was the opposite of the bitter lesson: specialized architecture and many mid-size wins beat pure Scaling.
views.zh: AlphaFold 2 是“苦涩教训”的反例：专用架构与众多中等规模改进胜过单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a cell model; it offers prediction and control, not understanding.
views.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的世界模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍留给人类。

views.en: Grand challenges yield practical tools; perfect interpretability is unnecessary, and science advances through many small ideas, not lone genius.
views.zh: 宏大挑战催生实用工具；完美可解释性并非必需，科学进步靠众多小想法而非孤独天才。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，算法更优的小模型可以超越大模型。

views.en: The core bottleneck is data: all methods reduce to data, and current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it; open research and abductive reasoning are key.
views.zh: 2023→2025 年：核心瓶颈是数据——所有方法最终都归结为数据，当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值而非超越；开放研究与溯因推理是关键。

views.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
views.zh: 2025→2026 年：预训练中的强化学习通过奖励信息增益来提升推理，尽管计算代价高昂；RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时降低 pass@k。

views.en: Small language models with high-quality, diverse synthetic data can outperform larger ones; post-training data diversity avoids mode collapse and homogeneity.
views.zh: 2026 年：拥有高质量、多样化合成数据的小语言模型可以超越更大的模型；后训练数据的多样性可避免模式崩溃与同质化。

views.en: Pluralistic alignment is needed because debiasing the internet is impossible; AI must respect diverse human values and norms.
views.zh: 始终：需要多元对齐，因为消除互联网偏见是不可能的；AI 必须尊重多元的人类价值观与规范。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with generalist agents like Gato tokenizing all inputs as a step toward AGI.
views.zh: AI 应增强人类能力，像 Gato 这样将所有输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning.
views.zh: 从 YouTube 等视频中学习有望无需昂贵的强化学习就能训练智能体。

views.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges today; we don't have solutions yet.
views.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们尚未找到解决方案。

views.en: Africa has leapfrogged legacy issues and is not behind in AI; language models can revolutionize local-language education.
views.zh: 非洲已跨越遗留问题，在 AI 上并不落后；语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

views.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential for beneficial technology, and fundamental innovation can come from anywhere.
views.zh: AI 社区的多样性与包容性对构建有益技术至关重要，根本性创新可以来自任何地方。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL can bridge the gap in robotics.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，好奇心驱动的无目标探索和样本高效的强化学习能弥合机器人学习中的泛化差距。

views.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; unlike language, there is no internet of robot data, so diverse data sources are essential.
views.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人学习本质上是数据问题；与语言不同，没有机器人数据的互联网，因此必须利用多样化的数据源。

views.en: A general-purpose brain pretrained on videos and simulation, post-trained on real data, can power any robot across form factors.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个在视频和模拟数据上预训练、在真实数据上后训练的通用大脑，可以驱动任何形态的机器人。

views.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics, requiring rigorous testing and a data flywheel across verticals.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化了观点：部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，需要严格测试和跨垂直领域的数据飞轮。
